title: Product Manager
description:
Description & Expectation:

Quadsat is looking for an experienced Product Manager to join the R&D team and take a key role in shaping and driving our defence product portfolio.

You will join the R&D organisation and work at the intersection of technology, customers, and business. The role combines strategic product management, defining product direction, priorities, positioning, and roadmap, with the operational responsibility of turning that direction into clear development priorities and ensuring progress across the organisation.

Our defence products combine RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into integrated solutions for the detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

You will work closely with engineering, commercial teams, partners, and end users to understand operational needs, translate market and customer insight into product priorities, manage and communicate the product roadmap, and help drive development from early concepts through product releases and continued improvement.

This is a role for someone who enjoys moving between the big picture and the detail: understanding where the product needs to go, while also staying close enough to development, customers, and delivery to help make it happen.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to take end-to-end ownership of product development and evolution. You will:

  • Own and drive product roadmaps aligned with Quadsat's strategy, market opportunities, and customer needs.
  • Translate customer, operational, and commercial input into clear product priorities and development initiatives.
  • Drive development from concept through implementation, validation, release, and continued improvement.
  • Maintain an overview of scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and progress, and communicate product status clearly across the organisation.
  • Work closely with engineers and technical leads to understand feasibility, effort, and realistic timelines for new capabilities and customer requests.
  • Collaborate with the R&D Director on prioritisation, resource planning, and allocation of engineering capacity across product lines.
  • Facilitate collaboration across R&D, Business Development, Marketing, Production, Quality, and other key stakeholders.
  • Stay close to customers, partners, and the defence industry, working with the commercial organisation to understand emerging needs and translate them into product direction.

The role offers significant ownership and the opportunity to influence both what we build and how we bring it to market, while remaining closely involved in the technical development required to make it happen.

Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in an engineering field, combined with strong practical experience in a similar role as a product or project manager.

In addition, you bring:

  • Experience translating customer or market needs into technical products and development priorities.
  • Experience within product management, technical product management, technical project management, or a similar role.
  • Experience from the defence industry or another mission-critical technical domain.
  • A strong technical understanding and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Fluency in English (both written and oral).

Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

Contact & Questions:

This hiring is being managed in collaboration with our external recruitment partner, ESBEES. For questions reach out to Søren Bøge Sørensen by mail: sbs@esbeesheadhunting.com or by phone: +45 20 27 46 66.

title: RF Systems Architect
description:
Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced RF Systems Architect to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will focus on RF front-end architecture, coherent receiver design, RF chain optimization, PCB design and layout, measurement integrity, and the continued productization of SpectraLoc. You will help strengthen the RF hardware foundation needed for robust product performance, certification readiness, and future next-generation RF architectures.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with engineers spanning from RF, DSP, software, embedded, and FPGA specialist, with your primary focus being to improve RF system quality, hardware robustness, and the measurement integrity of the sensing chain.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to develop, improve, and mature RF hardware and RF system architectures that support reliable RF sensing, geolocation, and future coherent receiver capabilities.

You will:

  • Design, develop, and optimize RF front-end architectures for RF sensing and geolocation applications.
  • Contribute to coherent receiver design, multi-channel RF architectures, and future direction-finding capabilities based on phase-coherent RF measurements.
  • Design and improve RF chains, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, gain distribution, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, and sensitivity trade-offs.
  • Support PCB design and layout for RF circuits, including component selection, schematic design, layout review, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and manufacturability.
  • Improve measurement integrity across the RF sensing chain by identifying and reducing sources of uncertainty, drift, phase error, loss, interference, leakage, and calibration sensitivity.
  • Plan and perform RF measurements, verification, and troubleshooting using relevant RF test equipment such as spectrum analysers, VNAs, signal generators, power meters, and related tools.
  • Work with DSP and software engineers to ensure that RF hardware behavior, calibration data, and system limitations are understood and properly reflected in algorithm development and product performance.
  • Support product robustness, certification readiness, and design-for-manufacturing activities by improving RF hardware quality, documentation, repeatability, and testability.
  • Provide technical leadership within RF systems and hardware, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s RF design, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.

Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Microwave Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in RF hardware development for RF sensing, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, test and measurement, or other advanced RF systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience designing, validating, and improving RF systems where measurement quality, robustness, and system performance matter.

In addition, you bring:

  • Strong practical experience with RF front-end design, RF chain architecture, and RF hardware development.
  • Experience with RF circuit design and PCB design/layout for high-frequency systems.
  • Solid understanding of RF system trade-offs, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, linearity, filtering, frequency conversion, phase noise, spurious signals, leakage, and sensitivity.
  • Practical experience with RF measurement, verification, debugging, and calibration using professional RF test equipment.
  • Understanding of coherent RF systems, including phase stability, synchronization, channel matching, LO distribution, timing effects, and calibration considerations.
  • Familiarity with antenna interfaces, propagation effects, polarization, multipath, and how RF hardware behavior affects sensing and geolocation performance.
  • Ability to define test methods, performance metrics, acceptance criteria, and validation approaches for RF hardware and RF sensing systems.
  • Experience collaborating with DSP, software, embedded, FPGA, mechanical, robotics, and product teams to turn RF hardware concepts into robust product capabilities.
  • A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while staying aligned with broader product and engineering priorities.

It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar systems, SIGINT, RF surveillance, phased arrays, coherent multi-channel receivers, interferometry, monopulse tracking, beamforming, calibration of RF sensing systems, MIL-STD certification, environmental robustness, SDR platforms, or transitioning RF hardware from prototype into production.

Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

Contact and Questions:

This hiring is being managed in collaboration with our external recruitment partner, ESBEES. For questions reach out to Søren Bøge Sørensen by mail: sbs@esbeesheadhunting.com or by phone: +45 20 27 46 66.

title: Academic Employee in Coordinated Robotic Shipbuilding
description:
SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP), part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a fully funded position as Academic Employee in the area of model- and simulation-based planning and control of robotic shipbuilding operations (such as hull welding). The position will be vacant from 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter for a 3-year period – with the possibility of extension. Main work location is Odense/Denmark at SDU and Odense Havn (Odense Port).

Research environment

The candidate will be part of SDU’s newly established Center for Large Structure Production (LSP). LSP’s central ambition is to provide a physical “go-to” lab for companies in the sectors maritime, construction and energy to carry out research, development and testing of novel solutions in the production of large structures, such as buildings, ships and offshore platforms. In this context, the candidate is expected to work closely with our industrial partners on application-oriented use cases, while helping to commission and operate the unique set of equipment of the center. 

LSP is closely working together the companies at Odense Havn and similar partners making large structures across Denmark and Europe. LSP is integrated with the Odense Robotics Cluster involving startups and established companies in robotics. We are a team of currently 17 researchers and engineers, specializing in robot solutions involving modelling, simulation, and control of advanced robot technologies (systems and services) for application-oriented industrial applications. 

Our group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team, with flexible work organization and support of individual development.

Job description

The position as Academic Employee is associated with projects in the sectors maritime, construction and energy. The overall objective of the project is to develop, control and demonstrate LSP’s robotic solutions for executing central production operations, such as welding, 3D concrete printing and composite layup. The main activities in the projects will be industrial R&D tasks carried out by LSP’s engineers in close collaboration with company partners. 

The starting point for the candidate to develop their academic profile in LSP will be to work on so-called “zero programming” methods and tools to define a digital workflow from product design to production operations. Based on analyzing digital product descriptions, the candidate will develop detailed mode-, simulation, and data-based control strategies to carry out the required production operations, including multiple robots, tools, and sensors. Facilitating Digital Twins, these control strategies will then be further developed into control of the physical assets in LSP, i.e. its unique multi-purpose/multi-robot gantry system.

Profile and requirements

The candidate is expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Documented education as engineer or technician

  • Documented experience with simulation of industrial robots

  • Strong programming skills (particularly in C/C++ and Python)

  • Ability to work independently as part of an agile team, with a strong sense of responsibility

  • Willingness to engage in application-oriented R&D, by closely interacting with company staff

In close teamwork with our researchers and staff from our industrial partners, the candidate will grow hands-on expertise in robotic production operations, including robots, tools, and sensors. 

Contact information

For further information, please contact Head of Center, Professor Christian Schlette via email (chsch@mmmi.sdu.dk) or on LinkedIn (www.linkedin.com/in/christian-schlette/).

Application deadline: December 2, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

"Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.”

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

title: Driftsleder/Supervisor til produktionen i Birkerød
description:
Der søges på vegne af vores samarbjedspartner i Birkerød (ENGLISH VERSION BELOW)

Vi er en dansk scale-up i Nordsjælland, der udvikler, producerer og sælger hampbaserede produkter. Vi arbejder med hele processen fra råvare til færdigt produkt og står overfor at udvide med egne produktionsfaciliteter, så vi kan lancere nye produktkategorier og skalere produktionen.Hverdagen er præget af høje krav til kvalitet, sporbarhed, dokumentation og stabile processer.

Om rollen

Vi søger en supervisor, der kan få den daglige drift i produktionen til at hænge sammen. Du skal skabe overblik på gulvet, følge op på opgaverne og være med til at sikre, at produktionen kører som den skal.

Det er en hands-on rolle, hvor du både deltager i arbejdet og har ansvar for den daglige koordinering i produktionen. Du bliver en vigtig del af teamet under Operationschefen og får en central rolle i at holde flow, kvalitet og fremdrift i hverdagen.

Personaleansvar er ikke et krav, men du skal have erfaring med arbejdsledelse eller daglig supervision i en produktionsvirksomhed.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Sikre den daglige koordinering og arbejdsfordeling i produktionen

  • Følge op på, at opgaver bliver løst korrekt og til tiden

  • Holde overblik over flowet på linjerne og reagere hurtigt ved stop, afvigelser eller flaskehalse

  • Deltage aktivt i produktionen, herunder betjening og overvågning af produktions- og fillingsprocedurer

  • Sikre hygiejne, sporbarhed og dokumentation på batch-niveau

  • Udføre og følge op på in-process-kontroller samt sikre, at kvalitetsdata er opdateret i de digitale systemer

  • Bidrage til orden, rengøring, first-level vedligehold på linjerne

  • Samarbejde tæt med lager og logistik om råvareflow og færdigvareafhentning

  • Være med til at forbedre arbejdsgange og skabe mere struktur i takt med, at produktionen udvikler sig

Din profil

  • Du har erfaring fra fødevare-, kosmetik-, pharma- eller anden procesindustri

  • Du har erfaring med arbejdsledelse, koordinering eller daglig supervision i en produktion

  • Du er vant til at arbejde struktureret og holde overblik i en travl hverdag

Production Supervisor – Hands-on Role

Location: Birkerød, North Zealand, Denmark

Recruitment on behalf of our partner company in Birkerød.

We are a Danish scale-up based in North Zealand, developing, manufacturing and selling hemp-based products. We manage the entire process, from raw materials to finished products, and are preparing to expand our operations with our own production facilities. This will allow us to introduce new product categories and increase production capacity.

Our daily operations require high standards of quality, traceability, documentation and process consistency.

About the Role

We are looking for a Production Supervisor who can help keep our daily production operations running smoothly. You will coordinate work on the production floor, follow up on tasks and help ensure that production runs efficiently and according to plan.

This is a hands-on position, combining active participation in production with responsibility for day-to-day coordination and supervision.

You will work as part of the team reporting to the Head of Operations and play an important role in maintaining production flow, quality and progress.

Formal line management or personnel responsibility is not required, but you must have experience supervising, coordinating or leading daily work in a manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Follow up to ensure tasks are completed correctly and on schedule.

  • Monitor production flow and respond quickly to interruptions, deviations and bottlenecks.

  • Participate directly in production, including operating and monitoring production equipment and filling processes.

  • Ensure hygiene, traceability and batch-level documentation.

  • Perform and follow up on in-process quality checks, ensuring that quality data is accurately recorded in our digital systems.

  • Maintain good housekeeping, cleaning routines and first-level equipment maintenance on the production floor.

  • Work closely with warehouse and logistics colleagues to coordinate raw material supply and the movement of finished goods.

  • Help improve workflows and establish more structured processes as production expands.

Your Profile

  • You have experience in food manufacturing, cosmetics, supplements, pharmaceuticals or another process-based manufacturing industry.

  • You have previous experience with production-floor supervision, work coordination or day-to-day production leadership.

  • You work in a structured manner and can maintain an overview in a busy production environment.

  • You understand the importance of quality, cleanliness and following established procedures.

  • You can read and write in Danish and/or English.

  • You are comfortable using digital systems and willing to learn new processes and tools.

  • You take responsibility, solve problems when they arise and actively contribute to keeping daily operations running smoothly.

What We Offer

  • Fixed daytime working hours, with flexibility by agreement.

  • Competitive salary, a company lunch scheme, an employer pension scheme and employer-paid private health insurance.

title: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are full-time and available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track).

Who we areIn electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model.

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within one or more of the following areas: communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, computing, cyber security, quantum technology, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide.

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Your profile and work tasksWe seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Communication• Networks• Antennas• Control systems• Sound• Artifical intelligence• Signal Processing• Computing• Quantum technology • Robotics

The main tasks and responsibilities include:• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.• participating in grant application activities• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment.

Your competenciesYou have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Qualification requirementsApplicants must have academic qualifications at PhD level. The potential of each applicant will be emphasized in the overall assessment

Tenure Track

When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on: 

  • The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
  • The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
  • The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
  • The candidate is a skilled communicator
  • The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
  • The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process

Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorshipThe assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

  • Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
  • Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
  • Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
  • The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
  • The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 

If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications.Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

title: Power System Engineer for Dynamics, Modelling and Control; DK - Fredericia
description:
The Danish power system is changing rapidly as wind, solar, batteries, power electronics and international connections play an increasingly important role. This creates new dynamic behaviour and calls for better models, analysis methods and engineering tools. As our new Power System Engineer, you help us understand these changes and turn complex analyses into practical solutions. You also help develop and maintain the simulation environment that supports our stability studies and engineering decisions.“We are looking for someone who enjoys building models and tools while keeping sight of the physical power-system problem they are intended to solve. A structured approach to maintenance, quality and processes is just as important as developing new solutions.”– Laurids Dall, ManagerJoin an international team of power-system specialistsAt our head office in Fredericia you join a highly specialised and international team working with power-system dynamics, stability and power quality. We support system operation, contribute to major technical projects and identify the capabilities the future power system will need. Close technical collaboration is an important part of our work, and we therefore expect you to work from the office at least two days a week.Shape the tools behind a stable power system and enhance our simulation environmentYour tasks depend on your experience and the projects you join. You will typically:
  • Perform dynamic stability studies and identify present and future system needs.
  • Develop and validate dynamic models and analysis methods.
  • Develop, maintain and quality-assure our simulation environment, primarily using DIgSILENT PowerFactory and PSCAD.
  • Automate simulations, screening and analysis workflows.
  • Translate technical findings into recommendations for system design and operation.
The job combines power-system engineering with structured development and maintenance. You help ensure that models, processes and results are documented, reproducible and suitable for reuse across the organisation. Within your first 6–12 months, we expect you to have:
  • Contributed professionally to stability studies or model-development activities.
  • Understood the structure and purpose of our simulation environment.
  • Improved at least one model, workflow or quality-assurance process.
  • Turned analysis results into clear technical conclusions.
  • Build effective working relationships within the team and across Energinet.
Combine technical curiosity with a structured approachYou have a MSc in electrical engineering or a related field. Your academic or professional background may include electrical power systems, power-system dynamics, power electronics, converter control or electrical energy systems. You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of relevant experience. We do not expect you to know every part of the field from day one. What matters is your technical foundation, willingness to learn and ability to approach complex engineering problems systematically. You check off one or more of the qualifications we are looking for:
  • Dynamic modelling and stability analysis in DIgSILENT PowerFactory or PSCAD/EMTDC
  • RMS or EMT simulation
  • Programming, scripting or automated engineering workflows
  • Model validation, documentation and quality assurance
  • Version control or collaborative software-development practices
Often the problems we work with do not have a predefined solution. You should therefore enjoy investigating complex technical questions, challenging assumptions and developing new approaches together with others. You will thrive in the role if you:
  • Are curious and want to understand why a system behaves as it does.
  • Enjoy building models and tools while keeping sight of the problem they are intended to solve.
  • Can structure complex problems, turn analysis into practical conclusions and take responsibility for progressing your own work.
  • Enjoy collaborating and sharing knowledge with other specialists as well as communicating complex topics to colleagues with different technical backgrounds.
Will you make a difference with us?We look forward to receiving your motivated CV no later than 20 December. You may want to pencil in a couple of dates in your calendar already. We expect the first interview to take place online on 5 January and the second interview in Fredericia on 11 January.If you have questions about the job, please contact Manager Laurids Dall ontel. +45 3092 3194.Special conditions: As Energinet performs tasks critical to society, we carry out background checks prior to employment. Employment is conditional upon your background check being compatible with employment at Energinet. The background check is also carried out once a year.The position also requires that you are able to obtain and maintain security clearance. On PET's website, you can read more about security clearance.We see diversity as a strength and encourage all qualified people, regardless of background, to apply for the job. We work actively and determinedly with diversity in Energinet and therefore encourage you to exclude information about age, marital status, etc. to minimise outage biases in the process. You can read more about our diversity policy here.Energinet Systemsansvar's core tasks are to integrate renewable energy, ensure equal access to the grids, develop market design, monitor, and balance the transmission grid and ensure security of supply in Denmark. We are a subsidiary of the Energinet Group, which represents the interests of society when supplying Denmark with electricity and gas and that the energy system is converted to green energy. Our culture is closely linked to our social responsibility, and we work actively with the UN's global goals on sustainable energy, climate action, partnerships for action as well as industry, innovation, and infrastructure. By leading the way in the green transition, we can help to solve the global climate challenge. New solutions require us to be able to see problems from many different angles, and diversity is therefore a keyword in our culture. We strive to listen to, involve and share our knowledge. Based on the values of courage and trust, we focus on constantly developing ourselves as an organisation and as people. Read more at our website www.energinet.dk.

title: DIAS Fellow in Industrial Ecology and Data-Driven Sustainability Assessment
description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and the Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invite applications for a tenure-track DIAS Fellow position at Assistant Professor level in Industrial Ecology and Data-Driven Sustainability Assessment, with a focus on input-output life cycle assessment methods and big data. The candidate is expected to start during the summer/early fall in 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter, in agreement with the successful candidate. 

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both the Department and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard assistant professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

Who are we looking for?

The position translates this ambition into a concrete research agenda, because many of the most pressing sustainability questions, such as how consumption in one country drives resource use, emissions and social conditions in another, or how a new technology changes environmental impacts across whole economies, cannot be answered within a single discipline. Industrial ecology addresses these questions by tracing material, energy and monetary flows through global supply chains, drawing on methods and data from engineering, economics and the natural and social sciences. Input-output analysis, built on big data covering production, trade, emissions and resource use and combined with life cycle assessment and material flow analysis, provides the quantitative framework for linking decisions about individual products, technologies and policies to their economy-wide consequences. The Fellow will build this capacity at SDU and use DIAS as a platform to work with researchers in fields such as health, food, energy, economics and political science on questions that cross disciplinary boundaries. Within this ambition, the specific profile is as follows.

We seek an early-career researcher who will advance quantitative sustainability assessment within industrial ecology by developing data-driven environmental-economic and systems models that link global production and consumption to environmental and socioeconomic outcomes. The role includes independent research, research-based teaching and supervision, interdisciplinary collaboration across DIAS and the Department, and development of competitive external funding proposals. Relevant research themes include:

·         environmental and material footprinting of global production and consumption systems;

·         development and application of environmentally extended input–output (EEIO) and multi-regional input–output (MRIO) models and databases, including hybrid physical–monetary systems and transparent, reproducible data workflows;

·         hybrid modelling that combines EEIO analysis with life cycle assessment (LCA), material flow analysis (MFA), econometrics or other quantitative methods;

·         applications to food and resource systems, healthcare systems and medical technologies, the circular economy, energy, infrastructure and other societal systems; and

·         scenario, structural decomposition, uncertainty and econometric analysis for sustainability transitions, policy and decision support.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

·         A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

·         A strong commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, contributing to research that bridges multiple fields.

·         Strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

·         Engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

 

Qualifications

Successful applicants must:

·         Hold a PhD or similar qualifications within relevant fields of industrial ecology, environmental or ecological economics, environmental science or engineering, sustainability science or a closely related field. To qualify for the position as Assistant Professor you must have obtained a PhD or similar degree by the application deadline. 

·         The successful candidate should demonstrate strong competence in EEIO or MRIO analysis, and at least one of the following areas: LCA, MFA, or hybrid modelling; econometric, statistical, or other quantitative methods; and programming, data science, or management of large, heterogeneous datasets.

·         Exhibit curiosity-driven research excellence, thinking beyond traditional boundaries.

·         Be fluent in English.

·         Show potential for attracting external research funding. Experience in applying for external funding and a strong international network are considered comparative advantages.

·         Have research publications that demonstrate their excellence and broad thinking. 

 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.   

The Department of Green Technology

The Department of Green Technology at SDU is a dynamic and interdisciplinary research environment focused on developing technologies and strategies for a sustainable future. Our research spans environmental chemistry, process engineering, life cycle thinking, and circular systems. We collaborate closely with industry and public stakeholders to ensure real-world impact and relevance.

This position will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering (SDU LCE).

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

SDU LCE uses industrial ecology approaches to reduce environmental impacts and reconcile human development with environmental stewardship. We conduct holistic systems analyses and design studies to characterise and optimise engineering solutions over the long term, considering resource use, energy efficiency, climate and environmental impacts, and economic and socioeconomic performance. At SDU LCE, we develop and apply theory, methods and tools for material flow analysis (MFA), life cycle assessment (LCA), life cycle engineering, energy-system analysis and design, resource-criticality assessment, process integration and techno-economic assessment.

 

Additional information

For further information about being a fellow at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk.

For further information about SDU Life Cycle Engineering and this position, please contact Head of Centre, Professor Morten Birkved, at morb@igt.sdu.dk.

 

Application, salary, and employment terms

The position is based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, in Odense and includes regular participation in DIAS and interdisciplinary collaboration.

Employment is governed by the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and the provisions for tenure track assistant professor as described herein. Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

The salary comprises a seniority-based base salary and a centrally agreed supplement.

Additional supplements may be negotiated locally.

As of 1 August 2026, the annual salary for an Assistant Professor is DKK 480,224.96 (salary level 6), consisting of a base salary of DKK 417,456 and a supplement of DKK 62,768.96.

All amounts are stated before tax, before added pension (18.07%), and any additional supplements. Pension contributions are paid by SDU, and both salary components (the annual salary and the supplement) are pensionable. For more details on salary and taxation, please see Further information on salary and taxation.

 

The tenure track programme is aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area.

Candidates enter at the assistant professor level (up to six years) and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position as associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee.  This evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential.

Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. The evaluation may also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities. 

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The programme includes annual performance reviews, a midterm evaluation by an expert panel, and a final academic assessment. If the final assessment is positive, the candidate will progress to a permanent position as associate professor. If the final evaluation is negative, the assistant professor may request one additional assessment within the last six months of employment. The tenure track period may be extended in connection with maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.

Equal opportunity employmentThe University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

Please go to our website for full information on how to apply.

The application deadline is February 28, 2027, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)

title: SMD Operators for a New Evening Shift

As an SMD Operator at NECAS, you will play a key role in the operation of our SMD lines – the heart of our electronics manufacturing. You will be responsible for setting up, monitoring and optimising processes, ensuring that production meets our high quality standards.

The electronics you help produce are used in everything from industrial and marine applications to defence and aerospace – industries where precision and reliability are essential.

You will become part of a highly skilled team and report to the Team Leader.

  • Work with supporting processes such as the washing machine and stencil cleaner

Quality and inspection

  • Ensure the correct handling of materials and components, including batch control, traceability and shelf life

  • Work in accordance with the IPC-A-610 standard (certification provided where required)

  • Record defects and deviations in the quality management system

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Ensure good communication and effective handovers between shifts

  • Share knowledge and support colleagues in their daily work

  • Contribute suggestions for improving processes and workflows

  • Maintain order and structure in the SMD area in accordance with 5S principles

About you

We are looking for a candidate who already has solid experience in SMD production and is able to work independently in a technically demanding role.

We expect you to:

  • Have a minimum of 3 years' experience with SMD equipment or electronics manufacturing

  • Be structured and able to maintain an overview, even during busy periods

  • Take responsibility and respond quickly when something deviates from the standard

  • Be a team player who contributes positively to the team

  • Have a technical understanding and an interest in working with advanced equipment

  • Language: good command of English, spoken and written

What we offer

At NECAS, you will become part of a growing company where quality and professional expertise are at the heart of what we do. You will receive:

  • A thorough introduction to our processes and equipment

  • Opportunities for relevant training and certifications, such as IPC-A-610

  • A strong team environment and an informal culture with a high level of professional expertise

  • A workplace in Støvring's newest industrial area, close to the E45 motorway

NECAS is one of Denmark's leading EMS companies, manufacturing electronics for the industrial, marine/offshore, defence, aerospace and scientific sectors – industries where quality and precision are essential. The company currently has 62 employees.

We are one of the few EMS manufacturers in Denmark with AS9100 certification for the aerospace industry. At NECAS, you will become part of a company experiencing significant growth, where you can develop your professional skills and help push the boundaries of Danish electronics manufacturing.

As we say: Build for trust.

Ideally, you have:

  • A structured and solution-oriented mindset.

  • Good administrative and analytical skills.

  • The ability to motivate and support colleagues.

  • Good IT skills, including Microsoft Excel.

  • Proficiency in Danish and English.

  • A valid Category B driving licence and VUB certificate.

Previous team leadership experience is an advantage, but your attitude, commitment and willingness to develop as a leader are equally important.

What we offer

  • A permanent, full-time position.

  • A varied role combining driving and team leadership.

  • Responsibility, influence and career development opportunities.

  • Close collaboration with management.

  • A supportive and ambitious working environment.

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience.

Join our journey

At UNIQ Logistics ApS, we believe in developing talent, recognising commitment and creating opportunities for our employees to grow alongside the company.

If you are ready to take on greater responsibility and make a difference, we would love to hear from you.

title: Erfaren Revisor / Bogholder hos eBogholderen
description:
Vi er inde i en rivende udvikling og har løbende brug for dygtige revisorer og bogholdere, der kan indgå i vores team på deltid/fuldtid, og hjælpe med at levere regnskabsydelser til vores mange nye kunder.

Vores vision er at blive Danmarks Bedste Revisor/Bogholder for små og mellemstore virksomheder.Vi ønsker at at hjælpe de mindste virksomheder, med at håndtere deres regnskabsbyrde, og levere kvalitetsregnskaber til Danmarks bedste priser. 

Arbejdet hos eBogholderen

Som Revisor / Bogholder hos eBogholderen, skal du være erfaren med håndtering og årsafslutning af små Enkeltmandsvirksomheder og gerne også selskaber.

Al bogføring bliver udført i online regnskabsprogrammer, og du bør som minimum have erfaring med Economic, Dinero og/eller Billy. Derudover skal du generelt være komfortabel med brug af IT og Internet. Og vi har også en forventning om at du selv kan tilegne dig relevant viden efter behov.

eBogholderen er en online virksomhed, og arbejdet udføres fra din egen arbejdsplads, eller fra hjemmet, når det passer dig. 

eBogholderen er en servicevirksomhed, og det er vigtigt at vi overholder de tidsfrister og deadlines som er aftalt, samt overholder vores forpligtelser over for kunderne.

Kvalifikationer - du skal have som Revisor/Bogholder hos eBogholderen:

  • Du skal have flere års erfaring med bogføring og håndtering af små virksomheder i forskellige brancher, typisk 0-10 ansatte.

  • Du skal selv have været ansvarlig for leverance til disse virksomhedskunder fra start til slut, og vant til at stå for kommunikationen direkte med kunderne.

  • Du skal have været vant til at arbejde med online regnskabssystemer.

  • Du skal være tryg ved brug af IT-systemer

  • Du skal have erfaring med at årsafslutte enkeltmandsvirksomheder.

  • Du skal bestå eBogholderens egen test og Certificering.

Det er desuden en fordel (men ikke et krav) hvis du:

Har erfaring med årsafslutning af selskaber, og har foretaget elektronisk indberetning af årsregnskaber til Erhvervsstyrelsen (Regnskab 2.0).

Har erfaring med VSO og KAO, samt erfaring i at bruge skatteberegningsprogrammer.

Alle Revisorer og Bogholdere der arbejder med os, vil blive testet og certificeret af eBogholderen.

Aflønning

Du aflønnes på timebasis, efter kvalifikationer.

Som erfaren Revisor/Årsafsluttende bogholder, kan du forvente aflønning fra 47-57.000 kr/md for 37 timers arbejde om ugen.

Din ansøgning/kontakt

Har du lyst til at blive en del af Danmarks hurtigst voksende regnskabsvirksomhed, og være en aktiv deltager i en virksomhed der konstant udvikler og flytter sig. Hvor du har en stor grad af medbestemmelse, men også ansvar, så send venligst en mail til Tamir Kuhr på mail: kundeservice@ebogholderen.dk

Din mail skal indeholde:

  • Dit CV - kort beskrivelse af din baggrund/erfaring

  • Beskrivelse af hvor meget tid du har til rådighed på ugebasis, som udgangspunkt minimum 20 timer

Hvis du gerne vil høre mere om arbejdsopgaven, er du velkommen til at kontakte Tamir Kuhr på telefon: 36991661.

title: Tilkaldevikar som køkkenmedarbejder
description:
Har du erfaring med madlavning og trives du med en varieret arbejdsdag i et køkken?

Vi søger en fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst tilkaldevikar til Liftra's køkkenteam, som kan træde til ved sygdom, ferie og ander fravær.

Hos Liftra tilbereder vi dagligt frokost til cirka 250 kollegaer. Vi lægger vægt på god mad, kvalitet og et godt samarbejde i køkkenet, hvor der også er plads til at afprøve nye retter og idéer.

Stillingen er uden et fast ugentligt timetal, da antallet af vagter afhænger af behøvet i køkkenet. Vagterne ligger på hverdage i tidsrummet kl. 07:00-15:00.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Tilberedning og anretning af varme og kolde retter

  • Opvask, oprydning og daglig rengøring af køkkenet

  • Andre praktiske opgaver i køkkenet efter behøv

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med madlavning fra et størkøkken eller lignende

  • Har kendskab til fødevarehygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med andre

  • Er mødestabil, fleksibel og har sans for orden

  • Tives med at hjælpe til, hvor der er behov

Det tilbyder vi

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med god kollegaer

  • En fleksibel tilkaldeordning med vagter efter behov

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med varierede køkkenopgaver

  • Et køkkenteam, hvor vi værdsætter samarbejde, ansvarlighed og god idéer

Sadan søger du

Har stillingen fanget din interesse? Så upload dit CV og en n kort ansøgning på dansk eller engelsk via vores ansøgningssystem.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at lukke stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Hos Liftra opfordrer vi alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen uanset køn, alder, religion, etnicitet eller baggrund.

title: Produktionsmedarbejdere til virksomhed i Vester Skerninge
description:
Vil du have et praktisk job, hvor du bruger kroppen, hjælper produktionen videre og kan se resultatet af din indsats?

Medarbejderne ApS søger for vores kunde i Vester Skerninge en produktionsmedarbejder, der trives med fysisk arbejde, klare opgaver og en hverdag, hvor teamet er afhængigt af, at alle tager ansvar. Du bliver en del af produktionen fra første dag og får oplæring i de opgaver, du skal løse.

Det her er jobbet

Det her er ikke et job, hvor du sidder stille. Du kommer til at arbejde med praktiske opgaver i produktionen, herunder håndtering af materialer, tungere løft og opgaver, hvor du står og går det meste af dagen. Arbejdet kræver, at du er fysisk aktiv, arbejder effektivt og hjælper teamet med at holde produktionen i gang.

Typiske arbejdsopgaver

  • Modtagelse og sortering. Du modtager skind fra danske, svenske og tyske slagterier og sorterer dem efter størrelse, vægt og kvalitet.

  • Forædling og maskinbetjening. Du deltager i selve garvnings- og forædlingsprocessen (f.eks. skrabning, spaltning og behandling, ved hjælp af specialiserede industrimaskiner.

  • Kvalitetskontrol og sporbarhed. Du udfører løbende visuel kontrol af skindets overflade for skader og sikrer korrekt registrering i systemerne.

Det er en fordel, hvis du

  • Har truckkort eller erfaring med at betjene truck.

  • Har erfaring fra produktion, lager, industri eller lignende praktisk arbejde.

  • Kan arbejde i både dag, aften og nat efter behov.

Arbejdstider

Primært arbejder du i daghold kl. 06.00-14.00. Der kan desuden være enkelte muligheder for at arbejde i aftenhold kl. 16.00-23.00 eller nathold kl. 23.00-06.00.

Du skal derfor være indstillet på, at arbejdstiderne kan variere efter produktionens behov.

Derfor er jobbet værd at overveje

Du får en praktisk hverdag med tydelige opgaver, oplæring og mulighed for at blive en del af en produktion, hvor dit arbejde gør en konkret forskel. Du bliver en del af et team, hvor samarbejde, sikkerhed og ansvar for dagens drift er vigtige elementer.

Vil du vide mere?

Skriv til Trine Jørgensen på tjo@medarbejderne, eller ring på 44124986, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Medarbejderne ApS er et veldrevet vikar-og rekrutteringsfirma, som med baggrund i en sund forretningsfilosofi og høj etisk standard er en stærk aktør på det danske marked. 

Vi har mere end 20 års erfaring med vikar- og rekrutteringsløsninger på alle niveauer og sætter en ære i at skabe kontakt mellem arbejdsgiver og arbejdstager. Medarbejderne ApS er landsdækkende og repræsenteret med kontorer i Horsens, Fredericia, Viborg, Hjørring, Hobro, Odense, Aabenraa, og Ringsted. Vi har ingen ambition om at blive Danmarks største vikar- og rekrutteringsfirma, men om at være det bedste!

title: Lagermedarbejder til status
description:
Har du styr på detaljerne, et godt overblik, og er du klar på en aktiv arbejdsuge i uge 50? 

Vores kunde i Greve mangler to medarbejdere til at hjælpe med status og optælling på deres lager i uge 50. Når der gøres status, går du systematisk lageret igennem og tæller de fysiske varer, så det sikres, at beholdningen på hylderne stemmer helt overens med tallene i systemet. Du spiller dermed en vigtig rolle i at give virksomheden et præcist overblik over deres varelager. Det er ikke et krav, at du har erfaring med lagerarbejde.  

Arbejdsopgaverne er:

• Optælling af varer og materialer på lageret 

• Registrering og kontrol af varebeholdninger (status) 

Vi forventer

• Du er motiveret og omhyggelig

• Du er ansvarlig og mødestabil

• Du kan arbejde både selvstændigt og i teams

Vi tilbyder

• Overenskomstmæssige forhold

• Gode kollegaer, der ligesom dig yder en tilfredsstillende indsats hver dag

Arbejdstiden er kl. 07.00-15.00 i uge 50 

Løn og ansættelse efter industriens overenskomst. 

Ansøg: 

Hvis du synes, at ovenstående lyder spændende, ser vi frem til at modtage dit CV. For at komme i betragtning til stillingen, skal du klikke "ansøg" og vedhæfte dit CV. Såfremt du ønsker at vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Silke Kruse på tlf. 92925121. Vi afholder løbende samtaler, og alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.

Om randstad

Randstad er verdens største HR-udbyder og ‘partner for talent’. Vi giver lige muligheder til alle uanset baggrund og hjælper kandidater med at forblive relevante på et hastigt skiftende arbejdsmarked. Vi tror på et inkluderende arbejdsmarked, hvor alle kan være sig selv og føle sig velkomne.

Vores markedsindsigt og store kendskab til arbejdsmarkedet hjælper virksomheder med at opbygge en kvalificeret, mangfoldig og fleksibel arbejdsstyrke, og vi støtter mennesker og virksomheder i at nå deres fulde potentiale. Det er det, vi er her for, og det er det, der motiverer os hver dag.

Randstad DK er en del af den internationale Randstad Group. Vi formidler dagligt arbejde til over 600.000 mennesker verden over og er førende inden for rekruttering, karriererådgivning og fleksibel arbejdskraft i Danmark, med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Aalborg og Kolding.

title: Vi søger netop dig - til vores skønne socialpædagogiske botilbud
description:
Har du en passion for at arbejde med voksne med psykiske og fysiske funktionsnedsættelser, og brænder du for at skabe tryghed og udvikling i deres hverdag? Så er det dig vi leder efter!

På Skelhøj, et socialpædagogisk botilbud i naturskønne omgivelser i Egedal kommune, søger vi en engageret pædagog til vores dedikerede team. Her får du mulighed for at arbejde i et stærkt fællesskab med fokus på faglighed, nysgerrighed og omsorg – alt sammen for at skabe det bedst mulige liv for vores beboere. 

Skelhøj er et socialpædagogisk botilbud, hvor vi dedikerer os til at skabe et trygt og inkluderende miljø for voksne med varierende behov. Vi anerkender og respekterer individualiteten hos alle vores beboere og stræber efter at forstå deres unikke behov og evner.

Stillingsoplysninger:

Vi søger en dygtig pædagog til vores team 3 og vores team 4. Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer, men vi er lydhør for andre ønsker. I Team 3 og team 4 bor der 7 beboere, med forskellige støttebehov, som gør din arbejdsdag alsidig. Den ene dag arbejder du måske 1:1 og er ude af huset med beboeren og den næste dag er du i huset og varetager flere beboers individuelle støttebehov.

Vi tilbyder et inspirerende arbejdsfællesskab præget af åbenhed, nysgerrighed og en stærk faglig tilgang. Vi værdsætter og støtter hinanden i et positivt og anerkendende arbejdsfællesskab, hvor vi ser diversitet som en styrke.

Dine primære opgaver inkluderer:

  • Sikre høj faglig standard i omsorg og støtte til beboerne.
  • Facilitere beboernes indflydelse på deres eget liv.
  • Yde socialpædagogisk støtte baseret på individuelle behov.
  • Opbygge og opretholde en positiv relation til beboernes netværk.

Læs gerne mere om opgaverne i funktionsbeskrivelsen via dette link: 

Socialpædagog: "Vi søger denne jobprofil"

Vores pædagogiske tilgang: Vi arbejder ud fra en neuropædagogisk tilgang med særlig opmærksomhed på low arousal-principper. Vores fokus er at skabe forudsigelighed, struktur og genkendelighed for at fremme ro og tryghed. Vi tager udgangspunkt i beboernes individuelle funktionsniveau, de inddrages i de daglige gøremål med fokus på mestring og aktiv deltagelse i eget liv, for herigennem at vedligeholde og udvikle deres kompetencer. Vi integrerer også bevidst fysiske rammer, dialog og tværfagligt samarbejde for at understøtte beboernes udvikling. Vi modtager supervision og tværfaglig sparring for at optimere og udvikle vores praksis i fællesskabet. 

På Skelhøj er vi i gang med en spændende udviklingsproces, hvor vi i 2025/2026 har haft et uddannelsesforløb for alle medarbejdere, i psykosocial rehabilitering og recovery, så vi sammen dygtiggør os og skabe et stærkt fagligt arbejdsfællesskab. 

Vi er også stolte over, at vi i 2024 var med i opløbet om Socialpædagogernes pris

Og de nominerede til Socialpædagogernes Pris er…

Vi tilbyder:

  • Grundig introduktion til kerneopgaven.
  • Varierede arbejdsopgaver.
  • Nærværende ledelse.
  • Et team med høj faglighed og fokus på psykologisk tryghed.
  • Engagerede kollegaer, der ser mangfoldighed som en styrke.
  • Skønne beboere.
  • Oplevelser med beboerne på tværs af Skehøjs 4 team samt deltagelse i musikarrangementer, Royal run og meget andet godt. 
  • Naturskønt område.
  • Gode parkeringsmuligheder.
  • 5 min. fra Veksø station. 

Som vores nye kollega er du:

  • Positiv og med en nysgerrig tilgang til brugergruppen.
  • Brænder for pædagogisk arbejde, uanset dit erfaringsniveau.
  • Rummelig, fleksibel og med et godt overblik.
  • Villig til forskelligartede opgaver, herunder personlig pleje.
  • Indstillet på at deltage i beboerferier.
  • Kørekort (ikke et krav men et ønske).

Arbejdstid:

Mellem kl. 7-22 med forventede dag/aftenvagter samt hver anden weekend. Der vil eventuelt være mulighed for enkelte lange vagter.

Ansøgning:

Hvis ovenstående beskrivelse matcher dine kompetencer og interesser, ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning. Vi afholder løbende ansættelsessamtaler.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

I overensstemmelse med gældende overenskomst og principper for Ny Løn. Der vil blive indhentet straffeattest ved ansættelse.

Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen på Skelhøj

Du er velkommen til at kontakte daglig leder Tina Hansen på mail: tina.m.hansen@egekom.dk eller på telefon 7259 7925 for at høre nærmere om stillingen.

title: Receptionist søges til Dyvig Badehotel
description:
Receptionist til fuldtidsstilling

title: Serviceleder søges
description:
Som serviceleder hos Sol Danmark A/S bliver du en del af en succesfuld virksomhed, der er kendt i branchen for sin kompromisløsekvalitet hos vores kunder. Vi har høje ambitioner, arbejder løbende med nye teknologier og uddanner selv vores medarbejderei høj servicekvalitet.

VI TILBYDER ET SPÆNDENDE JOB MED:

Oplysningspligt

Behandling af persondata ved rekruttering

Formålet med at indsamle personoplysninger om dig i rekrutteringsprocessen er at vurdere, om du er en kvalificeret kandidattil en ledig stilling hos Sol Danmark A/S.

Når du søger en stilling hos os, modtager og behandler vi en række personoplysninger om dig. Det gør, at vi er dataansvarligefor de personoplysninger, som vi behandler om dig.

Du finder vores kontaktoplysninger her Sol Danmark A/S, Transitvej 71, 7100 Vejle. Mail

info@sol-danmark.dk

og tlf. 7020 7000.

I forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen behandler vi almindelige personoplysninger om dig, men det kan også ske, at vibehandler særlige personoplysninger, CPR-nr. eller oplysninger om strafbare forhold. I denne tekst kan du læse mere om,hvilke oplysninger vi behandler om dig, når du søger en stilling hos os.

Når vi modtager din ansøgning

I rekrutteringsprocessen er det de personoplysninger, som fremgår af din ansøgning, CV og andre medsendte dokumenter, derbliver registreret.

Det vil typisk være følgende oplysninger: Navn, adresse, fødselsdato, køn, telefonnummer, e-mailadresse, CPR-nr.,ægteskabelig status, uddannelse(r), karrierehistorik, køre-kortoplysninger eller anbefalinger/referencer.

Vi anvender databeskyttelsesforordningens art. 6 (1) (b) som hjemmel, da der er tale om personoplysninger, som du selv harfremsendt til os med henblik på at blive ansat.

Vi registrerer de fremsendte oplysninger i vores personaleadministrationssystem.

Vi vurderer ansøgningen

Vi vurderer specifikt hver enkelt ansøgers kvalifikationer i forhold til den opslåede stilling. Når vi har læst ansøgningerne,udvælger vi kandidater til ansættelsessamtale(r).

Når vi har udvalgt dig til ansættelsessamtale

I forbindelse med ansættelsessamtalerne modtager vi yderligere oplysninger om dig, som vi noterer til brug for det vidererekrutteringsforløb. Vi anvender databeskyttelses-forordningens art. 6 (1) (b) som hjemmel, da der er tale ompersonoplysninger, som du selv har oplyst med henblik på at blive ansat.

Straffeattest

I nogle stillinger er det nødvendigt at se en straffeattest. Vi vurderer altid i forhold tilden enkelte stillings indhold, om det ernødvendigt at indhente en straffeattest.

Vi indhenter kun straffeattest, når du er blevet tilbudt en stilling hos os, og vi vil i den forbindelse først bede om dit samtykketil behandlingen.

Vi anvender samtykke efter databeskyttelseslovens § 8, stk. 3 som hjemmel, når vi indhenter straffeattester. Du kan til enhvertid trække dit samtykke tilbage. Det kan du gøre ved at kontakte os på kontaktoplysningerne ovenfor. Hvis du trækker ditsamtykke tilbage, har det først virkning fra dette tidspunkt. Det påvirker derfor ikke lovligheden afvores behandling afoplysningerne frem til tidspunktet, hvor du trækker dit samtykke tilbage.

Opholds- og arbejdstilladelse

Det er en betingelse for ansættelsen, at du har gyldig arbejds- og opholdstilladelse. For at sikre dette beder vi om en kopi af ditpas i forbindelse med ansættelsen.

Hvis du på grund af dit statsborgerskab skal have arbejds- og opholdstilladelse for at arbejde lovligt i Danmark, indhenter viogså kopi af din arbejds- og opholdstilladelse.

Vi anvender databeskyttelsesforordningens artikel 6 (1) c som hjemmel, når vi indhenter kopi af dit pas og eventuelt arbejds-og opholdstilladelse, da vi har pligt til at sikre dette efter udlændingelovens § 59, stk. 5.

Opbevaring og sletning

Hvis du får afslag, sletter vi de oplysninger, vi har registreret om dig, inden for 12måneder.

Hvis du bliver ansat, gemmer vi de oplysninger, som har været en del af rekrutterings-processen, i din personalemappe. Hvisvi har indhentet kopi af din straffeattest i forbindelse med rekrutteringen, sletter vi den, så snart vi har registreret, at vi har setdinstraffeattest.

Dine rettigheder

Efter lovgivningen i databeskyttelsesforordningen og databeskyttelsesloven har du en række rettigheder.

• Du har til enhver tid ret til at få indsigt i, hvilke personoplysninger Sol Danmark har registreret om dig

• Du har til enhver tid ret til at få berigtiget og opdateret de personoplysninger, som Sol Danmark har registreret om dig

• Hvis du anmoder om sletning, slettes alle oplysninger

• Såfremt du gør brug af din ret til indsigt, så skal du sende en underskrevet anmodning herom, der skal indeholde oplysningerom afsendermail på din ansøgning, omtrentlig eller præcis dato for fremsendelse, navn, adresse, telefonnummer og e-mailadresse. Henvendelse skal ske via

persondata@sol-danmark.dk.

Sol Danmark vil så vidt muligt indenfor 1 måned eftermodtagelsen af din sende denne til din e-mailadresse.

Du kan læse mere om dine rettigheder i Datatilsynets vejledning om de registreredes rettigheder, som du finder på

www.datatilsynet.dk

.

Klage til Datatilsynet

Du har mulighed for at klage over vores behandling af dine personoplysninger til Datatilsynet. Du finder Datatilsynetskontaktoplysninger på Datatilsynets hjemmeside

www.datatilsynet.dk

title: Vi mangler lige netop dig. Socialpædagog - der ønsker et job med mening og værdifulde øjeblikke.
description:
Et af dine vigtigste mål er, at du skal være med til at sikre at de beboere der bor her, lever de liv de ønsker og drømmer om.

Du skal guide, motivere og understøtte den enkelte til at nå sine mål i livet.

Dine opgaver er mangeartede ligefra personlig pleje, madpakke smørring, spil, musik, ture, nærvær mm.

Der bor 9 beboere i team B, med varierende behov for hjælp i alle livets facetter, fælles for dem alle er, at de glæder sig til at byde dig velkommen og særligt hvis du er med på noget sjovt.

Du vil blive en del af et miljø, hvor vi vil bruge din og dine nye kollegaers faglighed til at skabe et trygt og udviklende miljø. Samtidig med masser af omsorg, glæde og sjov i hverdagen.

Derudover arbejdes der målrettet med de fysiske rammer for at skabe ro, balance og fællesskaber alle kan være i.

Personalegruppen er bestående af 13 kollegaer, som vil glæde sig til at tage imod dig

Søvænge er et socialpædagogisk botilbud for voksne med fysiske og/eller psykiske funktionsnedsættelser. Vi er beliggende meget tæt på Ølstykke S-togstation – faktisk tager det kun 5-6 minutter at gå til Søvænge fra toget.

Hos os er det helt afgørende, at du kan arbejde med medbestemmelse og inddragelse i dagligdagens gøremål ud fra den enkeltes formåen. Vi vægter, at borgerne er trygge og har stor grad af indflydelse på eget liv. I dit arbejde er der derfor også en naturlig respekt for borgerens selvbestemmelsesret. 

På Søvænge er vi i gang med en spændende udviklingsproces, hvor vi har fokus på den neuropædagogiske forståelsesramme i det pædagogiske arbejde. Det betyder, at vi har planlagt undervisning i neuropædagogik samt modtager neuropædagogisk sparring løbende, således vi sammen dygtiggør os og skaber et stærkt fagligt arbejdsfællesskab. 

Videre er det centralt, at det sundhedsfaglige og pædagogfaglige vægtes lige og følges ad i arbejdet. Derfor skal du også være indstillet på at indgå i tværfagligt samarbejde med bl.a. sygeplejersker. 

Vi glæder os til at læse din motiverede ansøgning, dit Cv samt andre relevante bilag. Stillingen er som udangspunkt på 37 timer, men skriv gerne, hvad dine ønsker er. Det er vigtigt du har kørekort. 

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler; så skynd dig at skrive til os.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og principper for Ny Løn.

Det indhentes straffeattest inden ansættelsen. 

Vi er en røgfri arbejdsplads.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte:

  • Daglig leder, Britt Christensen på telefon: 72 59 79 97

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og trives med at arbejde selvstændigt

  • Er mødestabil, struktureret og har sans for orden

  • Har en positiv indstilling og bidrager til et godt samarbejde i hverdagen

Det tilbyder vi

Hos Liftra bliver du en del af en international virksomhed med en uformel arbejdskultur, hvor vi værdsætter samarbejde, ansvarlighed og respekt.

  • Et fleksibelt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø med gode kollegaer

  • En selvstændig rolle med ansvar for dine daglige opgaver

  • Frihed til at planlægge og tilrettelægge din arbejdsdag inden for de daglige serveringstider

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og værdsætter forskellige baggrunde og erfaringer

Sådan søger du

Har stillingen fanget din interesse? Så send os din ansøgning og dit CV på dansk eller engelsk via vores ansøgningssystem.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at lukke stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Hos Liftra opfordrer vi alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge stillingen uanset køn, alder, religion, etnicitet eller baggrund.
