title: Research Assistant followed by a Double Degree PhD position in Urban Design and Pedestrian Experience with AI and VR
employer: KU - SCIENCE - IGN frb campus omr. 3
description:
Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen Within the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Action (MSCA), University of Copenhagen is offering a 1-year Research Assistant (RA) position starting 1 April 2027 (or as soon as possible thereafter), which then leads to a 3-year PhD fellowship for a Doctoral Candidate (DC). The combined position is part of the research project STEP-UP (Safe, Thriving, and Engaged Pedestrians in Urban Public Spaces), which is funded by the European Union’s Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA), Doctoral Networks (DN), Call: HORIZON-MSCA-2025-DN-01. The STEP-UP network supports 10 PhD Candidates in investigating pedestrian behaviour and mobility in urban environments. The 10 PhD projects are closely linked, contributing complementary perspectives to a shared research agenda in three areas: individual and interpersonal aspects of pedestrian behaviour, environmental and infrastructural barriers to walking, and interactions between pedestrians and other road users. The aim is to improve the understanding of pedestrian mobility and support the development of safer and more inclusive urban public spaces. STEP-UP brings together academic and non-academic partners to train 10 doctoral candidates through an international Joint Doctorate programme. The candidates benefit from joint supervision by researchers at partner institutions, an integrated doctoral training programme, and opportunities for interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral collaboration, including research secondments at partner organisations. In addition to specialised scientific knowledge, they develop transferable skills in areas such as research communication and dissemination. The programme prepares them for careers in research and other fields related to transport and urban development. For a description of the STEP-UP project and descriptions of all 10 PhD positions, please visit the STEP-UP project’s website https://www.project-stepup.eu/ STEP-UP is based on 4-year double PhD degree programs. This means that the successful applicant will also be enrolled in a partner university’s PhD programme. Job and project description The RA position will entail carrying out a literature review of the research field, identifying current research gaps, and preparing for data collection. The PhD position will entail carrying out the research activities of the research project as described below. Your key tasks as a PhD fellow at the Faculty of SCIENCE are to:
  • Conduct an independent research project under supervision.
  • Complete PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points.
  • Participate in active research environments including a mandatory stay for a minimum of 12 months at the partner university (see below for further details).
  • Contribute to teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project (e.g., at conferences, meetings, etc.)
  • Write a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project
About the research project The project “Analysis of pedestrian experience and behaviour using Artificial Intelligence and Virtual Reality” will investigate how streetscape design elements influence pedestrian experience and behaviour using AI and VR. Advances in AI-driven environment generation and VR immersion now enable the creation and systematic testing of diverse, immersive streetscape scenarios, allowing assessment of pedestrian experience and behaviour that was previously infeasible. This PhD project will: (1) use AI tools to generate and manipulate 3D streetscape scenarios representing diverse urban design interventions; (2) integrate these environments into a VR platform for immersive pedestrian-experience; (3) conduct controlled experiments measuring emotional, behavioural and perceptual responses to assess walkability, experience and behaviour; and (4) run co-creation workshops with diverse groups (young and older adults, diverse genders and people with disabilities) and stakeholders (municipalities, local businesses, NGOs) to validate, critically assess and refine the methodology and findings. Partner university: University of Leeds. Planned secondments at University of Leeds: M12–M17 and M36–M47 Main Supervisor: Assoc. Prof. Kostas Mouratidis, University of Copenhagen, email: km@ign.ku.dk. Co-supervisor: Prof. Natasha Merat, University of Leeds, email: N.Merat@its.leeds.ac.uk Place of employment The primary place of employment will be Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and state-of-the-art hardware and software. More information on the department can be found here: https://ign.ku.dk/english/ During the PhD programme of research the candidate will be on a secondment for minimum 12 months in total at the partner university. Required qualifications As an applicant you must have:
  • To be eligible for the PhD programme at UCPH, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. Urban Planning, Geography, Civil Engineering, Psychology, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Sociology, or related-disciplines. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

  • Fluency in English (see Entry requirements | University of Leeds) and excellent communications skills.
Applicants will also be required to meet the European Commission’s MSCA Doctoral Network eligibility criteria, notably:
  • Mobility Rule - Applicants can be of any nationality and must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before the start of their employment at UCPH. Compulsory national service, short stays such as holidays, and time spent as part of a procedure for obtaining refugee status under the Geneva Convention are not considered.
  • Doctoral Candidate requirement – the applicant must not be in possession of a doctoral degree at the first day of the employment. Researchers who have successfully defended their doctoral thesis, but who have not yet been awarded the doctoral degree are not eligible.
Please note that you will only be considered for the position if you fulfil both above eligibility criteria. Who are we looking for? We are looking for candidates within the field(s) of spatial, engineering, or behavioural sciences. Applicants can have a background in Urban and Regional Planning, Geography, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Psychology, Sociology, or related disciplines. The following experiences and skills will be emphasised. Applicants are encouraged to provide relevant details and supporting evidence, where applicable:

title: Postdoctoral Researcher in Human Skin Biology and Wound Healing
description:
Postdoctoral Researcher in Human Skin Biology and Wound Healing Department of Biology, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen The Department of Biology at the University of Copenhagen invites applications for a postdoctoral researcher in human skin biology and wound healing. The position is part of a newly established research group investigating how cells coordinate their behaviour to maintain and repair tissues. The position is fully funded for at least 2 years, with the possibility of extension, through generous funding from the LEO Foundation. The earliest possible start date is 1 April 2027. Please clearly state your availability and preferred start date in your cover letter. Information about the Department of Biology is available at https://www1.bio.ku.dk/english/. Information about the specific research section you will be affiliated with is available at https://www1.bio.ku.dk/english/research/cbp/. Project overview The overarching aim is to develop strategies to help people with slow- or non-healing wounds. This project investigates how planar cell polarity (PCP)—the coordinated orientation of cells within a tissue—contributes to human skin organization and wound repair. Although PCP signaling is essential for tissue organization across many organisms, its role in human epidermis remains poorly understood. You will establish reconstructed human epidermis (RHE) as an experimental model to investigate PCP signaling in human skin, then use advanced fluorescence microscopy to characterize PCP clusters, their polarization, and how they change during wound repair and in response to other stressors. The project bridges fundamental questions in cell and developmental biology with potential long-term applications in regenerative medicine and skin repair. It is supported by collaborators with expertise in RHE development and by access to confocal and advanced microscopy, including SIM, TIRF, and STED. The project provides a clear starting point and room to shape the research questions as findings emerge. In your cover letter, please clearly describe what interests you about the project and what related research questions you would be excited to explore. Your role We are seeking a motivated, technically skilled, and scientifically independent postdoctoral researcher to play a central role in establishing this research programme. As one of the first members of a newly established research group, you will have an exceptional opportunity to shape its experimental approaches, contribute to its scientific direction, and help build a collaborative, ambitious research environment. Your primary responsibility will be to establish and optimize experimental systems to investigate PCP signaling in reconstructed human epidermis. You will work closely with the PI while taking substantial ownership of day-to-day experimental development and execution of the project. Your responsibilities will include:
  • Establish and optimize robust, reproducible assays with mature, stratified RHE cultures.
  • Develop and optimize immunostaining, advanced microscopy, and quantitative imaging workflows.
  • Analyze and interpret experimental data, contributing scientific ideas, and identifying promising new research directions.
  • Prepare manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals and presenting findings at local and international conferences.
  • Contribute to the development of a supportive, collaborative, and scientifically rigorous lab environment.
  • Help train and supervise students or other researchers as the group expands.
Profile We are seeking a curious and proactive researcher who can take ownership of their experiments while collaborating constructively with the project team. You do not need experience with every method listed below; training and collaboration will help you develop the techniques needed for the project. Essential experience and skills:
  • PhD in cell biology, developmental biology, skin biology, molecular biology, tissue engineering, biophysics, or a closely related field by the time of appointment.
  • Extensive hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture, with demonstrated ability to independently establish, optimize, and troubleshoot experimental protocols.
  • Demonstrated experience in fluorescence microscopy and immunofluorescence staining.
  • Evidence of scientific independence, initiative, and the ability to advance an experimental research project, including strong organizational skills.
  • A solid publication record appropriate for your career stage.
  • Excellent written and spoken English skills.
In the cover letter, you are encouraged to highlight an example of experimental independence, including situations in which you have established or substantially improved an experimental method, solved a challenging technical problem, or independently advanced a research project. Desirable experience and skills:
  • Experience with human keratinocyte culture, reconstructed human epidermis, organotypic skin cultures, or other 3D epithelial models.
  • Experience establishing new experimental model systems or developing and optimizing complex cell-culture protocols.
  • Experience with quantitative image analysis using Fiji/ImageJ, Python, or other comparable computational tools.
  • Experience with molecular perturbation techniques, including CRISPR/Cas9, RNA interference, and genetic manipulation of mammalian cells.
  • Experience with confocal microscopy or an advanced imaging technique such as SIM, TIRF, or STED.
  • Experience mentoring or supervising students or junior researchers.
Research shows that women and other underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you are excited about this position and believe you can contribute, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if your experience does not perfectly match every point. We value curiosity, motivation, and the potential and willingness to learn. What we offer
  • An opportunity to join a newly established research group and meaningfully contribute to its scientific development.
  • A central role in an ambitious, externally funded research project that addresses fundamental and medically relevant questions.
  • Substantial scientific independence and opportunities to develop novel experimental approaches.
  • Close scientific interaction with the PI and opportunities to shape future research directions.
  • Access to the research infrastructure and collaborative environment at the University of Copenhagen.
  • Opportunities for international collaboration, conference participation, publication, and professional development.
The position offers an excellent opportunity for a researcher seeking to develop greater scientific independence and strengthen their qualifications for a future academic or research leadership career. Terms of employment The average weekly working hours are 37 hours. The place of employment is at the Department of Biology, Section for Cell Biology and Physiology, University of Copenhagen. Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation. Currently, the monthly salary starts at 35,000 DKK/approx. 4,700 EUR (October 2021 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 17.1 % to your pension fund. Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years. The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2020. Questions For further information, please contact PI: Silas Boye Nissen; boye.nissen@bio.ku.dk. Foreign applicants may find this link useful: www.ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility). Application procedure Your online application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format:
  1. Motivated letter of application (max. one page).
  2. CV incl. education, work/research experience, and other skills/experience relevant for the position (see above).
  3. A certified/signed copy of a) PhD certificate and b) Master of Science certificate. If the PhD is not completed, a written statement from the supervisor will do.
  4. List of peer-reviewed publications.
Deadline for applications: December 31, 2026, 23:59 CET We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements. The further process After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/ The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities. The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

title: Massage Therapist (Zero hour Contract)
description:
The role:

As a Massage Therapist in our Copenhagen team, your role is to ensure clients' well-being by performing relaxing and cosmetic treatments following our established protocols. You'll also maintain our relaxation spaces in top condition with all the necessary materials for a perfect AIRE experience.

Key responsibilities:

Customer Experience:

  • Deliver relaxing treatments, including body and facial treatments and exfoliations, following AIRE's protocols and techniques for each. 

  • Clearly communicate treatment details and product information to clients, following our provided manual and protocols. 

  • Keep an ample supply of necessary products for customer experiences, promptly reporting any shortages or low stock. 

  • Maintain consistency in couples' treatments and coordinate effectively with partner therapists for a seamless experience.

Workplace:

  • Keep work areas clean and ready for customer experiences per company protocols. 

  • Supervise facility sanitation, product maintenance, and cleaning between treatments.  

  • Ensure environmental conditions meet protocol standards for noise, temperature, and humidity.

You'll receive thorough training to explore our diverse range of treatments and truly grasp the essence of AIRE's unique approach.

We're excited to welcome you to our team in Copenhagen and invite you to immerse yourself in the AIRE experience! 

Who we are looking for:

  • You have at least one year of experience in a similar role.

  • You hold a valid Massage Therapist course or certification

  • Fluent in English, and if you know Danish, that's a fantastic bonus!

  • You're genuinely customer-focused and excel at connecting with people

  • Your schedule is flexible, allowing you to work evenings, holidays, and weekends when necessary

Why you should join us:

  • Salary: Your hourly salary will be 182 DKK.

  • Zero hour Contract.

  • Supplement Pay: You will earn a supplement pay on weekends and holidays

  • Additional Pay Opportunities: You can earn extra pay through tips. In addition, we pay overtime

  • Career Progression: Explore career progression opportunities within our Therapists team: Senior Therapist, Supervisor, Manager

  • Pension Contribution: AIRE will contribute to your pension scheme

  • Referral Program: Get rewarded for referring potential colleagues

  • Birthday Gift: Enjoy an AIRE experience on your birthday!

  • Discounts: Benefit from 30% off on all our AIRE experiences

  • Canteen Perks: Access to coffee at our canteen, and fruits on the weekends!

  • Inclusive Work Environment: At AIRE, team spirit is our greatest asset! We are proud to have a welcoming and inclusive work environment where everyone's opinions and backgrounds are heard and respected. 

Copenhagen location

You will be delighted with our place in Copenhagen, located in the Carlsberg Byen district, where the former Carlsberg factory has been given a new lease of life and now is part of the magical AIRE atmosphere.

About 

AIRE Ancient Baths offer a timeless relaxation experience, inspired by ancient Roman, Greek, and Ottoman traditions, set in restored historical buildings in major global cities.At AIRE, we're delighted to have a global presence with eight established centers in cities such as NYC, Chicago, London, Copenhagen, Barcelona, Sevilla, Almeria, and Vallromanes. Looking ahead, we're excited about our upcoming Los Angeles and Madrid facilities soon.

title: INDUSTRIAL TECHNICIAN / MACHINIST - Næstved, South Zealand, Denmark - APPLICANTS WITH EU-PASSPORT ONLY
description:
GREAT WORKSHOP • COMPETITIVE PAY • RELOCATION SUPPORT FOR YOU AND YOUR FAMILYAre you an experienced machinist or industrial technician looking for a new opportunity abroad? At Service Shoppen, we are looking for a skilled and motivated colleague who enjoys precision engineering, turning and varied workshop tasks. Would you like to work in Denmark, enjoy a good work-life balance and become part of a friendly and professional workshop team? We would love to hear from you!A NEW JOB – AND SUPPORT WITH YOUR MOVE TO DENMARKMoving to another country is a big step, especially if you are bringing your family. We will help you get settled in Denmark – from airport pick-up and temporary accommodation to finding a permanent home and getting started with Danish language classes. If you wish to bring your family, we will also help you get started with the practical arrangements. Denmark offers good educational opportunities, schools and plenty of leisure activities for children and adults.THE JOBYour main responsibility will be NC turning, including working with our Weiler lathes, which can be operated both manually and through NC control. You will also take part in other varied workshop and production tasks. Set up, program and operate NC lathes. Perform manual turning when required. Read and understand technical drawings. Ensure high quality and precision in your work. Contribute to varied workshop tasks and suggest improvements.WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? You are a qualified Industrial Technician / Machinist or have relevant professional experience. You have experience with NC turning or CNC turning. You can work independently, take responsibility and take pride in quality work. You enjoy variety, teamwork and developing your skills. You can communicate in English. Danish is not required when you start. A valid EU passport is a requirement for this position.YOUR RELOCATION TO DENMARK – WE WILL HELPAIRPORT PICK-UPWe will pick you up at the airport and take you to your accommodation when you arrive.TEMPORARY ACCOMMODATIONIf needed, we will help arrange an apartment, a room or temporary bed & breakfast accommodation while you look for a permanent home.FINDING A HOMEWe will assist you in finding suitable permanent accommodation in Denmark.DANISH LANGUAGE SCHOOL & PRACTICAL HELPWe will help you get started with Danish language classes and guide you through practical matters related to settling in Denmark.PERSONAL CONTACT: Both of our managers speak English, and one of them is also fluent in Spanish. You will have someone to communicate with throughout the process and someone to turn to if you have questions.WHAT WE OFFER
  • DKK 205 per hour
  • 37 hours per week
  • 5 weeks + 1 additional week of holiday
You will also receive: An additional 10% of your salary through our free-choice scheme (fritvalgsordning), paid out twice a year. Employment conditions are covered by the DI/CO collective agreement, ensuring fair pay and proper working conditions. A flexible working environment. Thorough training and a proper introduction to your new job. Varied and interesting workshop tasks. A friendly and informal workshop with a strong professional focus.Holiday: 5 weeks of annual holiday plus 1 additional week of holiday days. Public holidays are also days off.ABOUT SERVICE SHOPPENAt Service Shoppen, you will become part of a professional workshop environment where precision, quality and practical skills are important. We offer varied tasks and a friendly, informal atmosphere, where colleagues work together and take pride in delivering good workmanship. You will have the opportunity to use your professional skills, learn new things and become an important part of our team.INTERESTED? LET’S TALK!You do not need to live in Denmark to apply. We are happy to arrange an initial online conversation to get to know you and answer your questions about the job, Service Shoppen and moving to Denmark.Send your CV and a short introduction to:Email: mail@service-shoppen.com Phone: +45 55 77 21 58Website: https://service-shoppen.com/RESUMEN EN ESPAÑOL | RESUMEN DEL PUESTOTÉCNICO INDUSTRIAL / TORNERO¡Trabaja en Dinamarca! Buen salario y ayuda con la mudanza para ti y tu familia.EL PUESTOEn Service Shoppen buscamos un técnico industrial o tornero con experiencia para formar parte de nuestro equipo en Næstved, Dinamarca. El trabajo consiste principalmente en torneado NC, utilizando tornos Weiler que pueden manejarse tanto manualmente como mediante control NC. También realizarás otras tareas variadas en nuestro taller. Es obligatorio disponer de un pasaporte válido de la Unión Europea (UE) para este puesto.¿QUÉ OFRECEMOS? Salario de 205 DKK por hora. Jornada laboral de 37 horas semanales. Las condiciones laborales se rigen por el convenio colectivo DI/CO, que garantiza un salario justo y unas condiciones laborales adecuadas. 5 semanas de vacaciones anuales más 1 semana adicional. También tendrás libres los días festivos. Un 10 % adicional del salario mediante nuestro sistema de libre elección (fritvalgsordning), pagado dos veces al año. Formación, un entorno de trabajo flexible y tareas variadas. Un ambiente agradable e informal con un fuerte enfoque profesional.¡TE AYUDAMOS A TRASLADARTE A DINAMARCA!Te ofrecemos ayuda con la recogida en el aeropuerto, alojamiento temporal, búsqueda de vivienda, clases de danés y los trámites prácticos para instalarte en Dinamarca. ¿Quieres trasladarte con tu familia? title: RF Systems Architect
description:
Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced RF Systems Architect to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will focus on RF front-end architecture, coherent receiver design, RF chain optimization, PCB design and layout, measurement integrity, and the continued productization of SpectraLoc. You will help strengthen the RF hardware foundation needed for robust product performance, certification readiness, and future next-generation RF architectures.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with engineers spanning from RF, DSP, software, embedded, and FPGA specialist, with your primary focus being to improve RF system quality, hardware robustness, and the measurement integrity of the sensing chain.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to develop, improve, and mature RF hardware and RF system architectures that support reliable RF sensing, geolocation, and future coherent receiver capabilities.

You will:

  • Design, develop, and optimize RF front-end architectures for RF sensing and geolocation applications.
  • Contribute to coherent receiver design, multi-channel RF architectures, and future direction-finding capabilities based on phase-coherent RF measurements.
  • Design and improve RF chains, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, gain distribution, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, and sensitivity trade-offs.
  • Support PCB design and layout for RF circuits, including component selection, schematic design, layout review, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and manufacturability.
  • Improve measurement integrity across the RF sensing chain by identifying and reducing sources of uncertainty, drift, phase error, loss, interference, leakage, and calibration sensitivity.
  • Plan and perform RF measurements, verification, and troubleshooting using relevant RF test equipment such as spectrum analysers, VNAs, signal generators, power meters, and related tools.
  • Work with DSP and software engineers to ensure that RF hardware behavior, calibration data, and system limitations are understood and properly reflected in algorithm development and product performance.
  • Support product robustness, certification readiness, and design-for-manufacturing activities by improving RF hardware quality, documentation, repeatability, and testability.
  • Provide technical leadership within RF systems and hardware, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s RF design, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.

Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Microwave Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in RF hardware development for RF sensing, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, test and measurement, or other advanced RF systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience designing, validating, and improving RF systems where measurement quality, robustness, and system performance matter.

In addition, you bring:

  • Strong practical experience with RF front-end design, RF chain architecture, and RF hardware development.
  • Experience with RF circuit design and PCB design/layout for high-frequency systems.
  • Solid understanding of RF system trade-offs, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, linearity, filtering, frequency conversion, phase noise, spurious signals, leakage, and sensitivity.
  • Practical experience with RF measurement, verification, debugging, and calibration using professional RF test equipment.
  • Understanding of coherent RF systems, including phase stability, synchronization, channel matching, LO distribution, timing effects, and calibration considerations.
  • Familiarity with antenna interfaces, propagation effects, polarization, multipath, and how RF hardware behavior affects sensing and geolocation performance.
  • Ability to define test methods, performance metrics, acceptance criteria, and validation approaches for RF hardware and RF sensing systems.
  • Experience collaborating with DSP, software, embedded, FPGA, mechanical, robotics, and product teams to turn RF hardware concepts into robust product capabilities.
  • A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while staying aligned with broader product and engineering priorities.

It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar systems, SIGINT, RF surveillance, phased arrays, coherent multi-channel receivers, interferometry, monopulse tracking, beamforming, calibration of RF sensing systems, MIL-STD certification, environmental robustness, SDR platforms, or transitioning RF hardware from prototype into production.

Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

Contact and Questions:

This hiring is being managed in collaboration with our external recruitment partner, ESBEES. For questions reach out to Søren Bøge Sørensen by mail: sbs@esbeesheadhunting.com or by phone: +45 20 27 46 66.

title: Academic Employee in Coordinated Robotic Shipbuilding
description:
SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP), part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a fully funded position as Academic Employee in the area of model- and simulation-based planning and control of robotic shipbuilding operations (such as hull welding). The position will be vacant from 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter for a 3-year period – with the possibility of extension. Main work location is Odense/Denmark at SDU and Odense Havn (Odense Port).

Research environment

The candidate will be part of SDU’s newly established Center for Large Structure Production (LSP). LSP’s central ambition is to provide a physical “go-to” lab for companies in the sectors maritime, construction and energy to carry out research, development and testing of novel solutions in the production of large structures, such as buildings, ships and offshore platforms. In this context, the candidate is expected to work closely with our industrial partners on application-oriented use cases, while helping to commission and operate the unique set of equipment of the center. 

LSP is closely working together the companies at Odense Havn and similar partners making large structures across Denmark and Europe. LSP is integrated with the Odense Robotics Cluster involving startups and established companies in robotics. We are a team of currently 17 researchers and engineers, specializing in robot solutions involving modelling, simulation, and control of advanced robot technologies (systems and services) for application-oriented industrial applications. 

Our group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team, with flexible work organization and support of individual development.

Job description

The position as Academic Employee is associated with projects in the sectors maritime, construction and energy. The overall objective of the project is to develop, control and demonstrate LSP’s robotic solutions for executing central production operations, such as welding, 3D concrete printing and composite layup. The main activities in the projects will be industrial R&D tasks carried out by LSP’s engineers in close collaboration with company partners. 

The starting point for the candidate to develop their academic profile in LSP will be to work on so-called “zero programming” methods and tools to define a digital workflow from product design to production operations. Based on analyzing digital product descriptions, the candidate will develop detailed mode-, simulation, and data-based control strategies to carry out the required production operations, including multiple robots, tools, and sensors. Facilitating Digital Twins, these control strategies will then be further developed into control of the physical assets in LSP, i.e. its unique multi-purpose/multi-robot gantry system.

Profile and requirements

The candidate is expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Documented education as engineer or technician

  • Documented experience with simulation of industrial robots

  • Strong programming skills (particularly in C/C++ and Python)

  • Ability to work independently as part of an agile team, with a strong sense of responsibility

  • Willingness to engage in application-oriented R&D, by closely interacting with company staff

In close teamwork with our researchers and staff from our industrial partners, the candidate will grow hands-on expertise in robotic production operations, including robots, tools, and sensors. 

Contact information

For further information, please contact Head of Center, Professor Christian Schlette via email (chsch@mmmi.sdu.dk) or on LinkedIn (www.linkedin.com/in/christian-schlette/).

Application deadline: December 2, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

"Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.”

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

title: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are full-time and available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track).

Who we areIn electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model.

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within one or more of the following areas: communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, computing, cyber security, quantum technology, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide.

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Your profile and work tasksWe seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Communication• Networks• Antennas• Control systems• Sound• Artifical intelligence• Signal Processing• Computing• Quantum technology • Robotics

The main tasks and responsibilities include:• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.• participating in grant application activities• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment.

Your competenciesYou have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Qualification requirementsApplicants must have academic qualifications at PhD level. The potential of each applicant will be emphasized in the overall assessment

Tenure Track

When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on: 

  • The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
  • The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
  • The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
  • The candidate is a skilled communicator
  • The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
  • The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process

Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorshipThe assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

  • Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
  • Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
  • Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
  • The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
  • The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 

If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications.Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

title: Warehouse work for peak season in Ringsted
description:
Ready for peak season? Join our warehouse team in Ringsted!

Black Friday is just around the corner – and we’re gearing up for our busiest time of the year!

At HumanizeR, we’re looking for energetic and reliable warehouse workers to join our logistics team in Ringsted as peak season kicks off. With Black Friday marking the start of an intense period, we need extra hands to keep thousands of parcels moving and ensure deliveries get where they need to be.

Looking for extra work, a flexible schedule, or a chance to get your foot in the door? This could be the perfect opportunity!

What will you be doing?

You’ll be part of a hardworking team keeping the logistics operation running smoothly. Your tasks will include:

  • Sorting parcels and preparing shipments.
  • Loading and unloading trailers.
  • Helping keep the flow of parcels moving during our busiest season.

No previous warehouse experience is required, training will be provided.

Choose your shift
  • Afternoon shifts: 12:00 - 22:00 (start time may change a bit)

Please note that end times may vary slightly depending on the daily workload.

Why join HumanizeR?
  • Flexible work: Choose when and where you want to work, depending on available shifts and assignments.
  • Earn extra money: Perfect if you’re studying or looking to boost your income ahead of the holidays.
  • Get valuable experience: Develop your skills in a fast-paced logistics environment.
  • Opportunities for the future: Show us what you can do and you may have the chance to move into a permanent position.
  • Great benefits: Including pension and holiday pay.
Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for people who:

  • Are reliable, motivated, and ready to get stuck in.
  • Bring positive energy and enjoy being part of a team.
  • Are comfortable working independently when needed.
  • Are physically fit and able to handle tasks involving heavy lifting.

Previous warehouse experience is a plus, but not a requirement. Your attitude and willingness to learn matter most!

Be part of the Black Friday rush!

Peak season is approaching fast, and we’re getting ready for the busiest time of the year. Join the HumanizeR team in Ringsted, gain valuable experience, and earn extra money while helping keep Denmark’s parcels moving.

Ready to get started? Apply today and join us for peak season!

Tagada, et kõik hooldustööd vastavad ettevõtte protseduuridele, ohutusstandarditele, tööloa (permit-to-work) protsessidele ja seadmete lukustamise/märgistamise (LOTO) nõuetele. Pidada täpset hooldusregistrit ning koostada ülevaatusaruandeid ja töökäske CMMS-süsteemis. Teha koostööd eritööde alltöövõtjatega ning toetada vajadusel seadmete kasutuselevõttu, remonti ja uuendamist. Tuvastada riske, teha parendusettepanekuid ja ennetada võimalikke seadmete rikkeid.

Omalt poolt pakume: Väljakutseid pakkuvat ja mitmekülgset tehnilist tööd, kus on võimalus töötada kriitilise tähtsusega hoonete taristuga, arendada erialaseid oskusi ning panustada keerukate tehnosüsteemide töökindlasse toimimisse.

Muud nõuded: Tehniline või kutseharidus KVJ, külmatehnika, mehaanikainseneri, hoonete tehnosüsteemide või seotud erialal.Vähemalt 5-aastane praktiline töökogemus KVJ- ja mehaanikasüsteemide hoolduses ärihoonetes, tööstusrajatistes või kriitilise tähtsusega keskkondades. Põhjalikud teadmised KVJ-süsteemidest, külmutusseadmetest, pumpadest, mootoritest, ventiilidest, laagritest, pöörlevatest seadmetest ja hoone mehaanilistest tehnosüsteemidest. Praktiline kogemus rikete otsimisel, ennetavas hoolduses, seadmete remondis ja süsteemide optimeerimisel. Hea arusaam CMMS-süsteemidest, tehnilisest dokumentatsioonist ja hoolduse planeerimisest. Ohutusprotseduuride, riskianalüüside, tööloasüsteemide ja seadusandlike nõuete tundmine. Tugev probleemide lahendamise, organiseerimis- ja suhtlemisoskus. Võime töötada iseseisvalt ning teha tõhusat koostööd alltöövõtjate, klientide ja kohapealsete meeskondadega. Hea eesti ja inglise keele oskus nii kõnes kui kirjas. Vene keele oskus tuleb kasuks. Väga hea arvutikasutusoskus (haldustarkvara ja Microsoft Office). Valmisolek töötada vahetustega graafiku alusel. Kehtiva juhiloa olemasolu on eelistatud.

Juhid 35-liikmelist meeskonda: osaled töötajate värbamises, juhendad ja koolitad töötajaid, koostad töögraafikuid ning korraldad asendusi. Kontrollid isiklikult objektidel töö kvaliteeti ja ohutusnõuete järgimist, selgitad välja puuduste põhjused ning tagad nende kõrvaldamise. Arvutad Excelis tööajanorme, töömahte, personali- ja materjalivajadust ning teenuste omahinda ja maksumust. Analüüsid kulusid ja ressursside kasutamise tõhusust. Suhtled klientidega, koostad ja põhjendad hinnapakkumisi, lepid kokku töökorralduslikke muudatusi ning lahendad igapäevaseid küsimusi ja pretensioone. Planeerid ja korraldad tööd nii, et teenuse kvaliteet oleks tagatud ning personali, tööaja ja materjalide kasutamine oleks tõhus.

Omalt poolt pakume: Konkurentsivõimelist töötasu. Stabiilset tööd BLRT Grupi ettevõttes. Iseseisvust töö korraldamisel ja võimalust oma teadmisi rakendada. Administratiivset tuge ostude, arvestuse ja dokumentatsiooni korraldamisel. Isikliku auto kasutamise hüvitist tööalaste sõitude eest. Kaasaegseid ja ergonoomilisi töövahendeid. BLRT Grupi töötajate tunnustamise poliitikas määratletud soodustusi. Tööpiirkond: Tallinn ja Maardu. Tööaeg: täistööaeg, paindlik tööajagraafik.

Muud nõuded: Kehtiv Puhastustööde juht, tase 5 kutsetunnistus. Puhastustööde korraldamise ja meeskonna juhtimise kogemus, vähemalt 3 aastat. Puhastustehnoloogiate, töömeetodite ja kvaliteedinõuete hea tundmine, sealhulgas tootmisruumide koristamise eripärade mõistmine. Hea Exceli kasutamise oskus: valemid, arvutused, liigendtabelid, tööaja ja kulude arvestus ning andmete analüüs. Hea arvutikasutamise oskus: MS Wordi ja Outlooki kindel kasutamine ning oskus töötada ettevõtte infosüsteemides ja koostada tööalast dokumentatsiooni. Analüütiline mõtlemine, iseseisev otsustusvõime, hea organiseerimisoskus ja vastutustunne. Oskus töötajaid juhendada ja õpetada, klientidega professionaalselt suhelda ning probleeme lahendada. Eesti ja vene keele oskus iseseisvaks tööalaseks suhtlemiseks ja dokumentidega töötamiseks, vähemalt B2-tasemel.

Tööülesanded: Füsioterapeut on spetsialist, kes taastab, säilitab ja arendab kliendi liikumis- ja tegevusvõimet ning tema osalust igapäevaelus.Füsioteraapia eesmärk, mis saavutatakse koostöös kliendi ja/või tema tugivõrgustikuga, on toetada ja arendada kliendi iseseisvust tema eale vastavates igapäevategevustes, sooviga parandada elukvaliteeti. Füsioterapeut kasutab oma töös klientidega erinevaid sekkumisviise (näit kehalised harjutused ja funktsionaalne treening, manuaalsed tehnikad, erinevaid füüsikalise ravi meetodeid jt). Füsioteraapia ülesanneteks on võimalike tervisekahjustuste ennetamine, liigeste liikuvusulatuse ja lihaste jõu säilitamine või parandamine, häirunud funktsioonide taastamine, kompenseerimine, valu leevendamine. Töö on nii lastega kui ka täiskasvanutega.

Omalt poolt pakume: - toetav ja sõbralik meeskond- paindlik töögraafik - enesetäiendamise võimalusi - motiveerivat töötasu

title: Kodushooldaja
description:
Koduhooldustöötaja

Tööülesanded: Aita inimestel elada väärikalt oma kodus!Estkeer otsib oma Tallinna meeskonda hoolivat, usaldusväärset ja vastutustundlikku koduhooldustöötajat. Meie töö eesmärk on toetada eakaid ja abivajavaid inimesi nende igapäevastes tegevustes, et nad saaksid võimalikult kaua, turvaliselt ja väärikalt oma kodus elada. Ootame oma meeskonda inimest, kellele läheb korda teiste heaolu ning kes soovib teha tähendusrikast ja vaheldusrikast tööd. Koduhooldustöötajana abistad kliente nende kodus vastavalt individuaalsele abivajadusele ja kokkulepitud hooldusplaanile. Sinu peamised tööülesanded on: *Abistamine igapäevastes hügieenitoimingutes (pesemine, riietumine, tualetitoimingud, mähkmete vahetamine). *Toidu valmistamine, serveerimine ja vajadusel abistamine söömisel. *Kliendi liikumise ja igapäevase aktiivsuse toetamine, abistamine liikumisel ning jalutuskäikudel. *Kergemad kodused majapidamistööd (koristamine, nõude pesemine, pesu- ja voodipesu vahetamine). *Toiduainete ja muude esmatarbekaupade ostmine. *Kliendi saatmine arsti vastuvõtule ja teistele vajalikele käikudele. *Vestlemine ja kliendi sotsiaalse aktiivsuse toetamine. *Tehtud hooldustoimingute dokumenteerimine. Töö toimub klientide kodudes. Tööpäeva jooksul külastatakse vastavalt graafikule ühte või mitut klienti. Külastuste kestus sõltub kliendi abivajadusest. Töö hõlmab hommikusi, päevaseid ja õhtuseid hoolduskülastusi ning vajalik on valmisolek töötada ka öistes vahetustes kliendi kodus.

Omalt poolt pakume: *Tähendusrikast tööd, kus Sinu panus mõjutab otseselt inimeste igapäevast heaolu.*Toetavat ja kokkuhoidvat meeskonda. *Sisseelamisprogrammi, kohapealset juhendamist ja regulaarseid sisekoolitusi. *Paindlikku töögraafikut ning võimalust töötada täis- või osalise tööajaga. *Mitmekesist ja iseseisvat tööd. *Tööks vajalikke vahendeid ja tööriietust. *Võimalust kasutada tööülesannete täitmiseks ametiautot või kokkuleppel isiklikku autot koos sõidukulude hüvitamisega. *Võimalust areneda ja täiendada oma oskusi hooldusvaldkonnas.

Muud nõuded: Nõudmised kandidaadile:*Vähemalt kutseharidus keskhariduse baasil. *Eesti keele oskus vähemalt B2-tasemel. *B-kategooria juhiluba. *Arvutikasutamise baasoskused ja valmisolek kasutada digitaalset hooldustöö dokumenteerimise süsteemi. *Valmisolek töötada graafiku alusel, sealhulgas õhtuti, nädalavahetustel ja vajadusel öösiti kliendi kodus. *Füüsiline ja vaimne valmisolek hooldustööks. OOTAME ESTKEERIGA LIITUMA KUI... *Oled empaatiline, hooliv ja sõbralik. *Oled kohusetundlik, aus ja usaldusväärne. *Suudad töötada nii iseseisvalt kui ka meeskonnas. *Oskad säilitada rahu ja leida lahendusi ka keerulisemates olukordades. *Oled tähelepanelik ning märkad muutusi kliendi enesetundes ja abivajaduses. *Austad kliendi privaatsust, väärikust ja iseseisvust. *Oled paindlik, hea suhtleja ja valmis õppima. *Sul on siiras soov aidata inimesi ja panustada nende elukvaliteedi parandamisse. Kasuks tuleb varasem hooldustöö kogemus või sotsiaal- ja tervishoiuvaldkonna haridus, kuid ootame kandideerima ka inimesi, kellel on sobivad isikuomadused ja soov valdkonnas töötada.

title: Sales Manager – Packaging Equipment and Automated Packaging Solutions
description:
Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Automated packaging lines and packaging equipment.

Work tasks: Alpina Electronics OÜ is expanding its activities in the field of automated packaging equipment and packaging lines and is looking for a Sales Manager for the Estonian and Finnish markets. Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Our range of solutions includes: Automated packaging lines and equipment in cooperation with the Polish manufacturer RADPAK. Palletizing equipment, including solutions developed by Alpina Electronics. Thermoforming packaging machines for the food industry, primarily for the Finnish market, supplied by Colimatic. Your Key Responsibilities Identifying potential customers and establishing new business relationships in Estonia and Finland. Visiting customers to understand their production processes and packaging requirements. Presenting suitable packaging equipment and automated packaging solutions. Working closely with equipment manufacturers and technical specialists. Managing sales projects from initial customer contact through to order confirmation. Every manufacturing company and project is different. Your role will be to understand each customer's specific needs and work together with our team and the manufacturers' technical specialists to develop the most suitable solution.

We offer: We offer an opportunity to play an active role in establishing a new sales division and developing the market for automated packaging equipment and packaging lines in Estonia and Finland. We offer: A competitive base salary combined with performance-based bonuses. An independent and responsible position with a high degree of autonomy. Flexible working arrangements, including the opportunity to work from home. A company car, computer, mobile phone, and all other necessary work equipment. Comprehensive technical support from equipment manufacturers and our own specialists. Manufacturer-provided training and opportunities to attend international trade fairs. The opportunity to contribute to the development of a new business area and influence the range of solutions we offer. The position involves regular customer visits throughout Estonia and Finland. Administrative and office-based tasks can be carried out from a home office. We prefer a full-time employee but are also open to part-time arrangements for the right candidate.

Other requirements: This position is ideal for someone who values independence, enjoys planning their own work, and wants to see a direct connection between their efforts and achievements.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: CEO Personal Assistant – Sales & Commercial Development
description: WE ARE HIRING – KIELO CONSULTANCY OYPersonal Assistant – Sales & Commercial Development**About Us**Established in Finland in 2021, Kielo Consultancy Oy specializes in professional services connecting buyers and sellers within Finland and between Finland and Vietnam.Since 2021, Kielo has successfully facilitated the official entry of a Finnish juice brand into the Vietnamese market.With our mission to connect businesses, promote international trade and support Vietnamese entrepreneurs, we continuously create business opportunities for individuals with strong sales capabilities.We always welcome commission-based sales partners in Finland for our current product portfolio, including Finnish juices, wild berries and berry-based products. These collaboration opportunities remain open without any limit on the number of partners.However, the following position is one of the few salaried positions at Kielo, offering a fixed salary alongside exciting business challenges and performance-based rewards.Position: Personal Assistant – Sales & Commercial DevelopmentThis is not a traditional personal assistant role. The position involves working closely with the CEO, supporting daily operations and commercial development, with a strong focus on sales.Key Responsibilities- Sales and business development of Finnish wild berries and related products. - Development of tropical fruit imports from Vietnam. - Customer and supplier acquisition, communication and relationship management. - Market, customer and supplier research. - Sales coordination, documentation and follow-up. - Supporting the CEO in daily operations and commercial activities. - Working towards agreed KPIs and business development objectives. Who We Are Looking For- Strong sales capabilities and an entrepreneurial mindset. - Proactive in identifying and developing business opportunities. - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. - Responsible, self-motivated and capable of working independently. - Good communication and business relationship management skills. - Willingness to take on challenges and grow through practical business experience. What We Offer- Permanent employment contract. - Regular working hours: 30 hours per week. - Fixed gross salary: EUR 1,700 per month. - 2% sales commission on net sales, excluding VAT, generated from customer accounts personally acquired and developed by the employee, subject to customer payment. - Flexible working arrangements depending on operational needs. - Opportunities to participate directly in business development and international trade between Finland and Vietnam. At Kielo, we are not simply looking for an assistant who follows instructions. We are looking for someone who can take initiative, identify opportunities and contribute measurable value to the business.If you have strong sales capabilities, a passion for business and the willingness to challenge yourself, we would love to hear from you.**KIELO CONSULTANCY OY – FINLAND**_Connecting People. Connecting Businesses. Creating Opportunities._

title: Sairaanhoitajan sijaisuus, Ikääntyneiden palvelut, Kuntouttava lyhytaikaishoito, Turku
description: Haemme sairaanhoitajaa sijaisuuteen Runosmäen vanhuskeskuksen kuntouttavan lyhytaikaishoidon osastolle ajalle mahdollisimman pian – 30.6.2027. TehtäväsiTyöskentelet Runosmäen vanhuskeskuksen 5. kerroksen kuntouttavan lyhytaikaishoidon osastolla 5B, jossa on 20 asiakaspaikkaa. Yksikössä järjestetään lyhytaikaishoitoa kotona asuville ikääntyneille 1–2 viikon jaksoilla. Tavoitteena on tukea asiakkaiden toimintakykyä ja kotona selviytymistä moniammatillisesti. Työssä hyödynnetään teknologisia ratkaisuja ja ergonomisia apuvälineitä sekä tehdään tiivistä yhteistyötä omaisten kanssa.Sairaanhoitajana toimit hoitotyön asiantuntijana ja työskentelet asiakaslähtöisesti asiakkaiden toimintakykyä tukien. Vastaat lääke- ja sairaanhoitoon liittyvistä asioista sekä kokonaisvaltaisesta hoitotyöstä yhteistyössä yksikön lääkärin ja muun tiimin kanssa. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat myös asiakkaiden toimintakyvyn ja hoidon tarpeen arviointi sekä opiskelijoiden ohjaus.Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?Saat yksilöllisen perehdytyksen ja tiimin tuen tehtävässäsi. Pääset tekemään merkityksellistä työtä moniammatillisessa yhteisössä, jossa työskentelyn tavoitteena on asiakkaan toimintakyvyn tukeminen ja mahdollisimman hyvä arki.Tarjoamme sinulle myös mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa työvuorosuunnitteluun ja työn organisointiin. Arvostamme osaamistasi, mutta toivotamme tervetulleeksi myös uransa alkuvaiheessa olevan motivoituneen sairaanhoitajan.Mitä odotamme sinulta?Toivomme, että olet motivoitunut kehittymään hoitotyön osaajana, työskentelet vastuullisesti ja tuot tiimityöhön oman osaamisesi sekä itseohjautuvan työotteesi. Eduksi luemme voimassa olevan LOVe-lääkeluvan sekä kokemuksen ikääntyneiden palveluista. Työ edellyttää hyvää suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa.Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/1994) mukainen sairaanhoitajan laillistus.Hae tehtävään ja tule mukaan Runosmäen vanhuskeskuksen kuntouttavaan lyhytaikaishoitoon!

description: TSL is a leading technical engineering and construction partner operating across EMEA, the Americas and APAC**Position Overview**TSL Projects Finland Oy is looking for an experienced EHS Lead to join our project organisation and support the delivery of major data centre construction projects in Mäntsälä and Vantaa, Finland.The EHS Lead will provide strategic and operational leadership in all Environment, Health and Safety matters, ensuring that the highest standards of health, safety and environmental management are implemented and maintained throughout the project lifecycle.Working closely with project management, construction teams, clients and subcontractors, the EHS Lead will drive a proactive safety culture, ensure regulatory and contractual compliance, and continuously improve EHS performance across project operations. This is a senior leadership position requiring extensive experience in EHS management within large-scale construction or industrial projects, together with the ability to lead EHS teams and influence safety performance across complex, multidisciplinary project environments.**Key Responsibilities**- Provide strategic and operational leadership for all EHS activities across assigned projects. - Lead, manage and develop the project EHS team, ensuring effective allocation of responsibilities and consistent implementation of EHS standards. - Work closely with project management, construction teams, clients and subcontractors to integrate EHS objectives into all phases of project planning and execution. - Develop, implement and maintain project-specific EHS management plans, policies, procedures and risk management strategies. - Ensure compliance with applicable Finnish legislation, regulatory requirements, client standards and company EHS policies. - Lead and coordinate EHS activities across subcontractors and their respective safety teams, ensuring a consistent approach to risk management and compliance. - Drive proactive safety initiatives, behavioural safety programmes and continuous improvement activities to strengthen safety awareness and workforce engagement. - Oversee the identification, assessment and mitigation of occupational health, safety and environmental risks throughout construction and commissioning activities. - Ensure effective implementation and review of risk assessments, method statements, job safety analyses, permit-to-work systems and other relevant safety documentation. - Plan and oversee regular site inspections, audits and EHS performance reviews, ensuring that findings are addressed through appropriate corrective and preventive actions. - Monitor EHS performance indicators, incident trends and safety statistics, identifying areas for improvement and reporting performance to project leadership and relevant stakeholders. - Lead incident investigations, including root cause analysis, and ensure that lessons learned are communicated and implemented. - Ensure effective EHS training, induction and competence development for project personnel and subcontractor workforces. - Coordinate emergency preparedness and response arrangements, ensuring appropriate plans and procedures are in place. - Provide expert EHS advice and guidance to senior management, construction teams and subcontractors. - Promote environmental awareness and ensure appropriate management of environmental risks and impacts arising from project activities. Represent the project in EHS-related discussions with clients, senior management, regulatory authorities and other relevant stakeholders.**Requirements**- Extensive professional experience (10+ years) in Environment, Health and Safety management within large-scale construction, industrial or infrastructure projects. - Proven experience in a senior EHS leadership role, such as EHS Lead, EHS Manager or equivalent. - Experience in developing, implementing and managing comprehensive EHS management systems and project-specific safety programmes. - Demonstrated experience in leading and managing EHS teams and coordinating safety activities across multiple subcontractors. - Strong knowledge of construction site health and safety practices, risk management methodologies and incident prevention. - Experience in managing EHS requirements throughout construction and commissioning phases. - Good understanding of occupational health, environmental management and applicable regulatory requirements. - Experience in conducting audits, inspections, incident investigations and performance reviews. - Ability to interpret regulatory and contractual requirements and translate them into practical project-level EHS procedures and plans. - Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage personnel at all organisational levels. - Ability to work effectively in an international, multidisciplinary project environment. **Fluent professional English, both written and spoken.**- Desirable Qualifications and Experience - Previous experience in data centre construction projects. - Experience in managing EHS operations on projects with large workforces and multiple subcontractor organisations. - Experience in developing behavioural safety programmes and driving measurable improvements in EHS performance. - Experience in construction-related environmental management and sustainability initiatives. - Recognised professional qualifications in occupational health and safety, such as NEBOSH Diploma or equivalent. - Relevant qualifications or training in auditing, risk management, incident investigation and emergency response. - Familiarity with international EHS management standards and management systems. **Application**Please submit your application and CV in English to our Snr HR Manager Riia Lampelo, riia.lampelo@tslprojects.com by 7th of December 2026.

title: Construction Manager
description: TSL is a leading technical engineering and construction partner operating across EMEA, the Americas and APAC.We are committed to creating the spaces to power the fourth industrial revolution, whilst ensuring we leave a positive environmental and social legacy for communities across the world. Specialising in Data Centres, Advanced Manufacturing, Logistics, Food and Pharmaceuticals, we are proud to deliver outstanding turnkey projects at speed, without compromise on safety or quality.Our team at TSL is focused on working with our clients and the entire supply chain to create a simple agenda concentrated on getting things done. At the heart of what TSL does is taking the noise out of project delivery whilst ensuring that we are always engineering best value for money and fit-for-purpose solutions.TSL is an equal opportunity employer, and we are especially proud that our dynamic, international team is made up of colleagues representing 57 nationalities across the world. We want big-picture thinkers who aren't afraid to roll up their sleeves, refusing to settle for "good enough" and pushing for great each time. We are firm believers that to build quality, you must invest in quality. We will continue to invest in our biggest asset: our amazing team.Position OverviewTSL Projects Finland Oy is looking for an experienced **Construction Manager** to join our project team for a major data centre development in Mäntsälä, Finland. The role may also involve assignments on other projects.The Construction Manager will be responsible for leading and coordinating site construction activities, ensuring that works are delivered safely, efficiently and to the required quality standards, while meeting project schedules and contractual requirements.This is a senior site leadership position requiring strong construction management experience, excellent coordination skills and the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams in a complex project environment.Key Responsibilities\- Take overall responsibility for the day-to-day management and coordination of construction activities on site.\- Lead and manage site management teams, subcontractors and other project personnel to ensure effective project execution.\- Coordinate civil, structural, architectural and MEP works, ensuring that interfaces between different disciplines are effectively managed.\- Oversee the delivery of CSA work packages, including coordination with MEP installation teams.\- Manage construction sequencing, short- and medium-term planning, and site logistics to ensure progress in line with the overall project schedule.\- Monitor construction progress, identify potential delays and implement corrective actions where necessary.\- Ensure that construction activities are carried out in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, design requirements and project standards.\- Coordinate design development and technical interfaces between engineering teams, subcontractors and site operations.\- Ensure that quality requirements are met through inspections, quality control procedures, benchmarks and formal sign-offs.\- Promote and maintain a strong health and safety culture across all site activities, ensuring compliance with applicable regulations and project requirements.\- Manage construction-related issues and resolve operational challenges in cooperation with the wider project management team.\- Maintain effective communication and collaboration with the client, consultants, design teams, subcontractors and other stakeholders.\- Drive the project towards successful completion, commissioning readiness and handover.Requirements\- Extensive professional experience (10+ years) in construction management and site operations, preferably on large-scale and technically complex construction projects.\- Proven experience in a senior construction management or senior site management position.\- Experience in managing multidisciplinary construction activities, particularly civil, structural and architectural works and their interfaces with MEP installations.\- Experience in data centre construction or other large-scale complex industrial or infrastructure projects.\- Strong understanding of construction methodologies, design coordination, construction sequencing and project delivery.\- Demonstrated ability to lead site management teams and coordinate multiple subcontractors and trade contractors.\- Strong knowledge of construction planning, scheduling, site logistics and progress monitoring.\- Good understanding of construction quality assurance and health and safety requirements.\- Ability to identify and resolve technical and operational challenges in a fast-paced project environment.\- Excellent communication, coordination and leadership skills.\- Fluent professional English, both written and spoken.Desirable Qualifications and Experience\- Previous experience delivering large-scale data centre projects.\- Experience in CSA package management and coordination of MEP interfaces.\- Experience in managing complex plantroom construction and technical building areas.\- Experience in design coordination, construction documentation and the transition from design information to site execution.\- Experience in quality management systems and digital construction management tools.\- Relevant construction-related education or equivalent professional experience.ApplicationPlease submit your application and CV in English to our Snr HR Manager, Riia Lampelo, riia.lampelo@tslprojects.com by 7th of December 2026.

Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!Bokförare – KorsholmVi söker en erfaren och bokslutskunnig bokförare för en tillsvidareanställning i Korsholm – vi erbjuder flexibel arbetstid (enligt överenskommelse 3–5 dagar/vecka), goda möjligheter till distansarbete, en lön på 2 500–4 000 €/mån för heltidsarbete (förhandlingsbar enligt erfarenhet och kompetens) samt Epassi-personalförmån!Arbetstiden är enligt överenskommelse 3–5 dagar i veckan utifrån den valda personens situation och önskemål. Epassi) under intervjun.Fyll i ansökan via länken intill, så kontaktar vi dig för att boka en tid för anställningsintervju. Intervjuerna inleds omgående och valet kan göras redan under ansökningstiden. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Numero on 050 542 1894 (finnish and english).--- Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökyselyMuutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

title: Projekti-insinööri
