title: Sjuksköterska till uppdrag på kommunen för vår och sommar 2027
description: Vill du ha större frihet i ditt arbete, utvecklas i din yrkesroll samtidigt som du har en förmånlig lön? Då är du varmt välkommen till oss på Te Crea Care!Te Crea Care etablerades 2013 och bemannar sjuksköterskor, fysio- och arbetsterapeuter. Vi har avtal med samtliga regioner, många kommuner och privata vårdgivare. Det innebär att vi kan erbjuda dig många olika typer av uppdrag i hela landet. Te Crea Care har löpande arbetat intensivt med anbudsarbete för att du som konsult ska ha många uppdrag att välja mellan till riktigt bra villkor. Vi arbetar tight med våra konsulter där vi är ett team.Krav eller önskemål:- Legitimerad sjuksköterska- Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skriftDu är flexibel och kan anpassa dig i olika arbetsförhållanden. Du är trygg i dig själv och har förmågan att prioritera, delegera och arbetsleda. Vi söker dig som värdesätter eget ansvar, delaktighet och som bidrar till ett positivt arbetsklimat. Du är lyhörd och bemöter människor med respekt och omtanke.Vi finns med dig hela vägen från uppdragsstart, löpande under uppdraget och när det är dags att se på fortsättning. Vi finns med alltifrån att hitta de bästa uppdragen åt dig, boka ev resa och boende, som bollplank under uppdraget och ligger steget före inför nästa uppdrag.Vi erbjuder dig:· Marknadskraftig lön· En dedikerad konsultchef· Komplett försäkring· Flexibel pension· Friskvårdsbidrag· Utbildningar· Tipsbonus· KonsultträffarI denna rekrytering tillämpar vi löpande urval. Du är varmt välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Är du intresserad av att veta mer om oss, kontakta Bemanningskoordinator Ebba på 0733759445 eller besök vår hemsida på www.tecreacare.com

title: Kyltekniker/servicetekniker
description: Energitjänst VK AB är ett väl etablerat värmepumpsföretag med mer än 30 år i branschen. Vi är idag ett sammansvetsat team med tretton anställda som nu söker nya kollegor på olika tjänster för att möta vår ökade orderingång. Verksamheten består i att sälja, installera och reparera värmepumpar för uppvärmning av fastigheter och villor med stort fokus på ett väl utfört arbete och nöjda kunder.Vi är ett auktoriserat IVT-center och återförsäljare för IVT’s produkter med service för tillverkaren Bosch/IVT som är Sveriges största tillverkare av värmepumpar.Besök gärna vår hemsida för mer information.Du är en självgående person som känner sig trygg i att arbeta självständigt och har en god servicekänsla.Dina arbetsuppgifter blir att serva och reparera värmepumpar ute hos kund. Vi söker dig med kyl-, el- och VVS-tekniska kunskaper.Dina kvalifikationer:Vi söker dig som har.    erfarenhet från arbete inom kylbranschen    stort intresse för teknik och lärande    kyl-, el- och VVS-tekniska kunskaper.    goda el- och styr/reglerkunskaper    goda kunskaper i både svenska och engelska    B-körkortDu ska vara en ansvarstagande och noggrann person som är bra på att samarbeta.

title: Ytbehandlingsoperatör
description: Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.Din rollÄr du teknikintresserad och har erfarenhet av ytbehandling? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig! På Magnetronavdelningen hos Saab i Järfälla producerar vi kritiska komponenter för avancerade radarsystem. Här ansvarar vi för hela processen, från produktion och kvalitetssäkring av magnetroner till leveranstester.I rollen som ytbehandlingsoperatör kommer du att genomföra olika typer av yt- och värmebehandling av ingående komponenter. Även analyser av kemiska bad förekommer för att säkerställa kvalitet.Som ytbehandlingsoperatör kommer du bland annat ha följande ansvarsområden:    Ytbehandling av mekaniska detaljer    Egenkontroll av ytbehandlade detaljer (sker främst under mikroskop)    Analyser av kemibad.    Självständigt analysera fel, göra bedömningar och föreslå åtgärder tillsammans med andra avdelningar    Administration och rapportering av fel i våra system    Ansvar för att underhålla utrustning tillsammans med underhållspersonalVi är en grupp på cirka 20 personer med blandade bakgrunder, erfarenheter och åldrar. Här finns en stark gemenskap och en öppen, trivsam stämning där både samarbete och eget ansvar är viktigt. Vår blandade kompetens gör att vi lär av varandra och tillsammans når våra mål.Din profilVi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för tillverkning och vill bli en del av ett team med gedigen teknisk kompetens. Du är en självgående person som gillar att ta ansvar och arbeta praktiskt med teknik i fokus. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som värdesätter samarbete och bidrar till en positiv arbetsmiljö.Vi ser gärna att du har:    Erfarenhet eller utbildning inom ytbehandling, exempelvis från gymnasium, högskola eller motsvarande praktisk bakgrund    Intresse och grundläggande förståelse för kemi och materialteknik    Goda språkkunskaper i både svenska och engelska, i såväl tal som skrift    Vana att arbeta med dator och grundläggande kunskaper i program som Excel, Word och PDFDet är starkt meriterande med erfarenhet från industriell tillverkning, särskilt inom ytbehandling. Även utbildning eller erfarenhet inom kemiska processer är meriterande.Befattningen kan komma att placeras i säkerhetsklass, vilket innebär att du måste genomgå och godkännas i en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd innan anställning.I och med kommande ledighet i december kan återkoppling komma att dröja, din ansökan kommer att hanteras i januari - men du är välkommen med din ansökan redan nu!Vad du blir en del avUpptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.

title: Inköps- och upphandlingsavdelningen söker en inköpsassistent
description: Om arbetsplatsenInköps- och upphandlingsavdelningen tillhör Regionkontorets ekonomifunktion, tillsammans med övriga verksamheter inom ekonomifunktionen ansvarar vi för att leda, samordna och utveckla de regionala processerna för planering och uppföljning, redovisning och finans, upphandling och inköp samt fastighet. Uppdraget omfattar både att ge stöd och ledning till regionens förvaltningar och bolag utifrån våra ansvarsområden samt att stödja politiken i deras uppdrag.  Region Hallands inköpsverksamhet är av strategisk betydelse och ska säkerställa att regionens inköp är kostnadseffektiva och rättssäkra, tillvaratar konkurrensen på marknaden, främjar innovativa lösningar, visar ekologisk och social hänsyn samt har en säkrad försörjning och leveransförmåga vid olika nivåer av kris. Region Halland har en central inköps- och upphandlingsavdelning som ansvarar för såväl regiongemensamma som förvaltningsspecifika upphandlingar. Variationen i uppdragen är stor, här hanteras allt från hälso- och sjukvårdens behov, till kollektivtrafik, skola och kulturInköpsstöd är en del av inköp och upphandling och ansvarar för det operativa inköpsarbetet som e-handelsadministration/registervård, beställningar och utveckling av e-handel. Utöver detta är support till verksamheten gällande inköp och beställning en viktig del av arbetet.ArbetsuppgifterEn av våra medarbetare kommer att vara ledig under en period och därför söker vi nu dig som vill kliva in som en viktig förstärkning. Som inköpsassistent kommer du att arbeta bland annat med inköpssupport till beställare, e-handelsadministration och direktupphandlingar. En viktig del i ditt arbete kommer att vara att strukturerat och effektivt arbeta med leveransförseningar och leveransstörningar.Arbetet innebär även att ha kontakt med både beställare inom regionen och med externa leverantörer. Du kommer att arbeta i nära samarbete med kollegorna på inköpsstöd, med upphandlare, materialkonsulent och med övriga roller på inköp och upphandling samt logistikfunktionen. Tillsammans med dina kollegor utvecklar du nya arbetssätt för att fortsätta områdets utvecklingsresa med implementering av nya systemstöd under kommande år.Vi erbjuder ett stimulerande och omväxlande arbete som samtidigt ställer höga krav på affärsmässighet, integritet och noggrannhet.  Din profilVi söker dig med:    Avslutad gymnasieutbildning.    Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift.    Vana att arbeta med kvalificerat datorstöd.    God administrativ kompetens och noggrannhet.Vi söker dig som har en tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet i yrke inom administrativt arbete. För att trivas i den här rollen behöver man vara initiativtagande och serviceinriktad. Vi söker därför dig som tycker om att möta människor och har ett professionellt förhållningssätt, där du är lyhörd och smidig i ditt bemötande. Avdelningen befinner sig i en utvecklingsfas och söker därför dig med utvecklingsdriv. Du har en vilja att prova och utvärdera nya arbetssätt samt kommer med egna förslag på lösningar. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.För att du ska lyckas i din roll krävs att du har en god kommunikativ förmåga och kan prioritera. I ditt arbete är du självgående, flexibel och strukturerad.Det är meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av inköp.Är det dig vi beskriver? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!Urval och intervjuer kommer att ske fortlöpande under ansökningstiden.Vårt erbjudandeFör oss är det viktigt att du ska trivas och utvecklas i ditt arbete. Läs mer om vad Region Halland kan erbjuda dig som medarbetare här.Om Region HallandRegion Halland är till för alla som bor och arbetar här i Halland. Vi är över 8 000 medarbetare inom 370 olika yrken som alla arbetar för att erbjuda en god hälso- och sjukvård och att främja tillväxt och utveckling. Vi ansvarar också för kollektivtrafiken i Halland och driver frågor inom områden som näringsliv, kultur och utbildning. Vår vision är ”Halland ­ – bästa livsplatsen” och med det menar vi att Halland ska bli den bästa platsen att bo på, utbilda sig, arbeta och driva företag i. Vi har kommit en bra bit på vägen, välkommen att följa med oss på vår resa! Läs mer om Region Hallands organisation, vårt uppdrag och vår vision.Strävan efter jämställdhet, mångfald och likvärdiga villkor är både en kvalitetsfråga och en självklar del av Region Hallands värdegrund.Region Halland krigsplacerar all tillsvidareanställd personal.Region Halland följer främst det centrala kollektivavtalet HÖK (Huvudöverenskommelsen) med bilagor som AB (Allmänna bestämmelser), i vissa fall kan även avtalet BEA användas. HÖK med bilagor hittar du på www.skr.seTill bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare:Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser. Region Halland har upphandlade avtal.

title: Senior konsult Cybersäkerhet | Financial Services | Stockholm
description: Vill du bidra till att stärka den finansiella sektorns digitala motståndskraft? Som senior konsult i vårt cybersäkerhetsteam arbetar du med ledande aktörer inom finanssektorn och ger råd inom cyberrisk, strategi och styrning. Du driver kunduppdrag, utvecklar kundrelationer och bidrar till våra tjänster och vår verksamhet. Möjligheten: Du hjälper våra kunder att stärka sin digitala motståndskraft och hantera komplexa frågor inom bland annat kontinuitet, IT- och cyberrisk, tredjepartsrisk och regulatorisk efterlevnad. Rollen kombinerar strategisk rådgivning med praktiskt genomförande och nära samarbete med både ledning och specialistfunktioner. Ansvarsområden: I rollen kommer du bland annat:    Driva och genomföra kunduppdrag inom cybersäkerhet och digital risk, från planering och analys till leverans och uppföljning.    Rådgiva kunder inom cyberrisk, styrning och motståndskraft genom att analysera förändrade hotbilder och omsätta threat intelligence till strategier och konkreta åtgärder inom bland annat kontinuitet, tredjepartsrisk och regulatorisk efterlevnad.    Stödja kunder i att identifiera och hantera framväxande risker kopplade till teknikutvecklingen, inklusive frontier AI.    Leda projekt och team samt skapa struktur och framdrift i komplexa uppdrag.    Bygga och utveckla långsiktiga relationer med våra kunder och samarbeta nära kollegor med olika specialistkompetenser.    Bidra till utvecklingen av våra tjänster och marknadserbjudanden samt delta i affärsutveckling och offertarbete. Kvalifikationer för tjänsten: Vi söker dig som har:    Relevant akademisk examen inom exempelvis datavetenskap, informationssäkerhet, cybersäkerhet, företagsekonomi med inriktning mot IT eller motsvarande.    Minst två års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom cybersäkerhet, informationssäkerhet, IT-risk eller närliggande område.    Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt. Vi ser gärna att du har:     Erfarenhet från konsultverksamhet eller annan rådgivande roll.    Erfarenhet från bank, försäkring eller annan del av den finansiella sektorn.    Erfarenhet av regulatoriska ramverk och krav, exempelvis DORA, NIS2, Finansinspektionens regelverk eller EBA:s riktlinjer.    Relevanta certifieringar, exempelvis CISM, CISSP, CISA, CRISC eller CBCI.Erfarenhet inom områden som operativ motståndskraft, Business Continuity Management (BCM), IT-risk, tredjepartsrisk, cyber governance, threat intelligence eller framväxande teknologier såsom frontier AI. Som person är du:     Ansvarstagande och bekväm med att självständigt driva arbetet framåt.    Analytisk och strukturerad med förmåga att omsätta komplexa frågor till tydliga slutsatser och rekommendationer.    Relationsskapande och kommunikativ och trivs med att arbeta nära både kunder och kollegor.    Affärsmässig och kundorienterad med ett genuint intresse för att skapa värde för kunden.    Intresserad av affärsutveckling och motiverad av att bidra till nya kundrelationer och affärsmöjligheter. Är du redo att ”Shape your future with confidence”? Ansök idag. Välkommen att söka tjänsten! Vänligen skicka in din ansökan senast den 21 december 2026. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Vid frågor gällande tjänsten, kontakta Angelica Holmgren på Angelica.Holmgren@se.ey.com. Vid frågor gällande rekryteringsprocessen, kontakta Adrian Lyng på Adrian.Lyng@se.ey.com. Tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Observera att en bakgrundskontroll kommer att genomföras som en del av rekryteringsprocessen. På EY främjar vi en inkluderande miljö och värdesätter olikheter. Vi uppmuntrar ansökningar från kandidater med olika bakgrunder och strävar efter en rättvis rekryteringsprocess. Vid behov av stöd eller anpassningar, kontakta vårt rekryteringsteam på recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com.EY | Building a better working world EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Senior Embedded Software Developer, Secure Meters (Sweden) AB
description: Are you a skilled Embedded Software Developer with deep experience in Embedded Linux and C programming? Do you want to build solutions for the global energy transition together with an international engineering team?Secure Meters is looking for an experienced Senior Embedded Software Developer to join the engineering team in Nyköping.In this role, you will work on innovative and technically challenging projects, developing embedded software solutions and reusable components while exploring emerging technologies. You will collaborate closely with the local Swedish engineering team as well as engineering teams in India.Location: Nyköping, Sweden (Hybrid, minimum 3 days per week on-site).The RoleAs a Senior Embedded Software Developer at Secure Meters, you play a key part in designing and delivering high-quality software for advanced energy measurement and grid management systems. You take ownership of technical challenges from concept to deployment, working with modern toolchains and automated testing to ensure reliability and scalability.Key Responsibilities    Design, develop and maintain embedded software solutions, primarily using Embedded Linux.    Contribute to overall system architecture and software design.    Develop portable, reusable software components and evaluate new technologies through prototypes and proof-of-concept projects.    Write high-quality, efficient and maintainable code supported by automated testing.    Collaborate with engineering teams in Sweden and India to deliver innovative technical solutions.    Participate actively in technical discussions, code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions.    Keep up to date with emerging technologies, industry trends and best practices in embedded systems.    Continuously develop technical skills and share expertise through team meetings, workshops and mentoring.Qualifications & ExperienceYou may currently work in a role such as:    Senior Embedded Software Developer    Embedded Linux Engineer    Firmware Engineer    Embedded Systems ArchitectEssential requirements:    Minimum 6 years of professional embedded software development experience.    Bachelor's degree (BSc) in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent.    Strong hands-on experience with Embedded Linux.    High proficiency in C programming.    Solid understanding of system architecture and software design principles.    Demonstrated experience in writing portable and reusable code, verified by automated testing.    Hands-on experience using Git daily in modern team workflows.    Practical experience with JTAG/SWD or remote debugging techniques.    Experience with developing, integrating and utilizing open-source software packages.    Experience with Jenkins, CI/CD pipelines and modern build workflows.    Professional working proficiency in English (spoken and written).Desirable experience:    Experience working with RTOS (Real-Time Operating Systems).    Domain background in power grids, energy management, smart metering or industrial data acquisition.    Experience building rapid prototypes and evaluating emerging hardware/software technologies.    Conversational or professional Swedish is an advantage.Personal AttributesTo thrive in this role, we believe you are:    Innovative, curious and open-minded, with a genuine interest in exploring new technologies.    A technical problem-solver who takes ownership of challenges and proactively drives solutions.    Comfortable working in an international, collaborative and supportive team environment.    Driven by a continuous learning mindset, eager to develop and share knowledge with colleagues.    Adaptable to evolving project requirements, technologies and engineering practices.About Secure MetersSecure Meters is a global provider of advanced solutions for measuring, monitoring and managing energy consumption. With more than 7,200 employees across 10 countries, we are a leading player in the energy sector, partnering with utilities and businesses to create sustainable, efficient and innovative solutions for electricity distribution and transmission. Our products are deployed in over 70 countries, helping customers make better, data-driven decisions about their energy use. Through continuous engineering innovation and customer focus, we remain at the forefront of the industry.To learn more about our business and how we drive progress in the energy sector, visit www.securemeters.com to explore our solutions and our commitment to a sustainable future.We welcome you to join our engineering team in Nyköping and contribute to Secure Meters' continued growth and technology leadership!ApplicationWe collaborate with Addilon in this recruitment. Please submit your application (CV and cover letter in English) as soon as possible via the link below. The selection process is ongoing and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

title: M&C Insights & Performance Lead

Most importantly, you enjoy working with data, finding patterns others miss, and helping people make better decisions through evidence and insight. You are energized by building new capabilities and creating lasting organizational change.

title: Postdoc Position in Innovation & Family Business at the House of Innovation
description: The roleThe House of Innovation (HoI) invites applications for a two-year postdoctoral position primarily within a research project examining how ownership structure and family involvement shape innovation and firms' participation in internationalization, particularly amid geographical tensions and their impact on global networks. There will also be opportunities to contribute to other research projects within the Center for Family Enterprise at House of Innovation. The successful candidate will join a research team within a dynamic research environment and work at the intersection of family business, innovation, international business, strategy, and research policy. The main project associated with this postdoc position focuses particularly on family-controlled firms, investigating how governance and ownership influence firms’ innovation in the context of geographic and technological reach, access to external knowledge, and responses to geopolitical shocks. The position will be based at the House of Innovation and involve collaboration with Professors Mattias Nordqvist and Valentina Tartari, as well as other members of the project team, including Marco Mismetti and Lorenzo Palladini.  Your profileThe ideal candidate will have developed a clear research agenda during their PhD and be motivated to collaborate on publications aimed at leading international journals. The position offers opportunities to pursue new research questions using unique and large-scale quantitative data, as well as qualitative methods. There will be opportunities to teach and to engage with practice through our ample network of family business owners, leaders and advisors. A background with experience and high proficiency in either qualitative empirical methods or quantitative empirical methods is mandatory. Priority will be given to candidates with research relevant to the topics above. Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a requirement. We expect the candidate to live in or relocate to Stockholm. Applicants must hold a PhD by the start of employment. To be eligible, they must have obtained their doctoral degree within the three years preceding the start of employment. This period may be extended only where special circumstances apply.How to apply: Formal submission will be via the SSE Varbi online platform. To apply, please submit the following documents:     A curriculum vitae     A cover letter articulating the candidate’s fit with the position description, including research interests and teaching experience.    A separate document listing both published articles (if any) and articles submitted to journals.    Copies of representative research.    Names and contact information for three persons willing to provide references. Your application should be received by December 23, 2026 (CET). For questions about the position, please contact Mattias Nordqvist (Mattias.Nordqvist@hhs.se) For HR-related questions, please contact Elma Jacobson (Elma.Jacobson@hhs.se) About the House of Innovation (HoI) The House of Innovation provides an excellent, interdisciplinary environment for research, education, outreach and venturing, with scholars working in Technology and Innovation Management, Entrepreneurship, Information Systems, Operations and Supply Chain Management, and adjacent fields. HoI collaborates with a broad, influential network of academics, corporations, government agencies, and civil society actors, with the aim to contribute to the advancement of society. HoI hosts an expanding group of international scholars with currently 8 professors, 6 associate professors, 16 tenure-track assistant professors, 17 PhD students and more than 35 research fellows and postdocs. Our researchers have access to important national research networks, such as WASP-HS, and are highly successful in publishing and grant acquisition, for example, with a recent major research grant on AI in healthcare. HoI faculty members regularly publish in top journals, and serve on editorial boards, in editorial positions, and in academic leadership positions. They frequently receive substantial grants from leading Swedish and European funding institutions to conduct state-of-the-art research, and serve on national and international policy committees, thus contributing to the shaping of society and of innovation ecosystems.  HoI encompasses the academic Department of Entrepreneurship, Innovation and Technology, the Jacob and Marcus Wallenberg Center for Innovative and Sustainable Business Development, the Scania Center for Innovation and Operational Excellence, The Center for Family Enterprise, The Center for Transformative Innovation, Center for Data Analytics, the research platform on innovation and sustainability within the House of Sustainable Society, and the Swedish Center for Digital Innovation (SCDI Sthlm). We also run the SSE Business Lab start-up incubator and coordinate SSE’s involvement in the Stockholm School of Entrepreneurship (SSES), a consortium with the six major universities in Stockholm providing innovation and entrepreneurship education across the wider Stockholm area and beyond.

title: PhD Student in Applied Geophysics
description: Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.We are recruiting a PhD student for a research project on regional exploration in Norrbotten, Sweden. Project is aiming to create a regional 3D geophysical model of the subsurface to guide mineral exploration and provide hints for possible deposits. Take the opportunity to study for a PhD in interdisciplinary, dynamic, international research environment in close collaboration with industry and leading universities worldwide.Subject descriptionApplied Geophysics is a topic based on physical laws and practices, which combined with geological information can be used in a variety of applications. Geophysical research at the Division of Geosciences and Environmental Engineering includes both basic and applied research in exploration, environmental and engineering applications.Project descriptionRex project focuses on a full multi-scale geophysical prospecting for mineral exploration with added value of regional scale surveying for exploration targeting. Previous D-Rex project showed that by conducting geophysical surveys across regional-to-deposit scale it is possible to identify regional patterns, structures and anomalies that can be used to guide deposit-scale exploration.Geophysical images transcending from continental- to deposit-scale can provide a better understanding of the geology of the region and how mineral deposits were formed and distributed. While allowing the identification of potential mineral deposits at a continental scale, and then focusing on specific areas for detailed exploration, they also lead to improved accuracy of mineral exploration by providing a more complete picture of the subsurface geology.DutiesAs a PhD student you are expected to perform both field work and theoretical work within your research studies as well as communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. The majority of your working time will be devoted to your own research studies. You will work primarily with geophysical (magnetotelluric) data. 3D geophysical data modelling/inversion is a key focus of this PhD. You will work on development and extending our MR3Dmod modelling/inversion framework. In addition, you will have the opportunity to try the teacher role. As a PhD student, you work as a neutral party in many contexts, which provides a great opportunity to be involved in challenging development projects.QualificationsYou must have academic credentials and recently completed your M.Sc or equivalent degree in geophysics, mathematics, physics, geology or other relevant subject. Good understanding of theory and numerical methods used in modelling and inversion is required. Experience in software development (Python in particular) and management of large data sets is important. You are expected to work in a team and are open to collaborate with colleagues and external partners. Fluent written and spoken English is required.For further information about a specific research subject see; http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=enMost employees in the research subject exploration geophysics are currently men therefore provided that the qualifications are the same, the underrepresented gender will be given priority.Further informationEmployment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%. title: Senior Open Pit Mining Engineer
description: Experienced in open pit mining? Take on broad technical responsibilities and help shape the future of mining at Björkdalsgruvan.Would you like to use your experience in open pit mining to influence both technical solutions and operational practices? As a Senior Open Pit Mining Engineer at Björkdalsgruvan, Sweden, you’ll take on broad responsibilities covering mine design, mine planning, drilling, blasting and water management.You’ll join a lean organisation with short decision-making processes, working closely with production and seeing your recommendations put into practice. In this newly established role, you’ll share your expertise and contribute to both the existing open pit operation and the planning of a larger future open pit.This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise with a broader perspective on mine development in an international environment where English is the working language.Purpose, Offer and Benefits    Work in a lean organisation with close collaboration and the opportunity to see your technical recommendations put into practice.    An international and collaborative work environment where people, safety, practical problem-solving and continuous improvement are key priorities.    A flexible and rewarding work environment with competitive employment conditions and benefits, including a wellness allowance and a healthcare fund.    Flexible working hours based on trust and 30 days of annual leave.Your Responsibilities    Develop and optimise open pit mine design, mining sequences and short- and long-term production planning.    Plan bench development and mining sequences, contributing to the future development of Björkdal´s open pit operations.    Provide technical support for drilling and blasting, including design, quality control and performance monitoring.    Work with dewatering, drainage and water management to prepare new mining areas.    Monitor production performance and technical data, translating analysis into improvements in safety, productivity and cost efficiency.    Support production technicians through technical problem-solving, knowledge sharing and the development of operational practices.The Bigger PictureThis is a full-time, permanent position based at Björkdalsgruvan, near Skellefteå, Sweden. You will work regular daytime hours with flexible working arrangements based on trust and responsibility. The role is primarily site-based, with some flexibility depending on operational needs.This is a newly established position where you will work closely with a small team consisting of two production technicians and a supervisory function. Initially, you will report directly to the Mine Manager and collaborate with the mine´s other planning functions.Björkdal´s open pit operations are entering an exciting phase of development. The existing open pit has an expected remaining operational life of 3–4 years, while a potential expansion of the original Björkdal main open pit could extend operations by at least another 5–6 years. This offers you the opportunity to contribute to both ongoing production and technical challenges that will shape the mine´s long-term development.Our ExpectationsThe most important qualification is several years of hands-on technical engineering experience in open pit mining operations. You may have worked as a Mining Engineer, Open Pit Engineer, Mine Planner or Drill and Blast Engineer.To succeed in this role, you will need:    Several years of hands-on technical engineering experience in open pit mining.    A solid understanding of mine design, mine planning, drilling and blasting.    A degree in Mining Engineering or equivalent relevant experience.    Experience with mine planning and design software, along with the ability to learn new systems.    A valid Category B driving licence and good English communication skills.It would be an advantage if you have:    Swedish language skills.    Experience supporting and developing other technical team members.As a person, you are solution-oriented and confident in your technical judgement. You can identify challenges, develop practical solutions and clearly communicate your recommendations to colleagues with different areas of expertise. You are comfortable working independently while also valuing close collaboration with production and technical teams.Interested?The recruitment process is carried out in collaboration with Talent Navigation Group (TNG), a recruitment and staffing company, and the technical recruitment specialists at TNG Tech. By taking a broader perspective on technical expertise, they identify more engineers, technicians and managers who match the needs of Swedish employers, both today and in the future.We look forward to receiving your application with your CV or LinkedIn profile. No cover letter is required.Please note that we do not accept applications via email, but you are always welcome to contact the recruiter by email if you have any questions.Once you have submitted your application, we will anonymise your personal information and invite you to complete a couple of recruitment assessments before conducting an initial objective evaluation. You will receive more information about each step as the process progresses, and you can track the status of your application in real time through our website.Please note that applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Project Controls Manager
description: Project Controls Manager The European Spallation Source (ESS) will soon be the world’s most powerful source of neutrons, providing researchers with unique opportunities to explore the structure of materials at the atomic level. Neutron scattering at ESS will address critical questions in physics, chemistry, geology, materials science and life science. We are now looking for a Project Controls Manager to oversee the operational and development project scope at ESS.   About the role: The Project Controls Manager (PCM) plays a critical role in ensuring the best use of the human and financial resources for the ESS organisation. They are responsible for establishing and maintaining the systems, processes, and governance needed to plan, monitor, and control organisational performance and the ESS programme. The role provides leadership across planning and scheduling, cost control, risk management, change control, and reporting to support informed decision-making and successful delivery. Working closely with project managers, technical leads, finance, procurement, operations, and other stakeholders, the PCM will have a central overview of both the operational and development project scope. This is a permanent role based at ESS campus in Lund, Sweden.   Day-to-day, you will:     Supervise a team managing cost control, planning, risk, change control and reporting functions.      Lead the development, maintenance, and governance of integrated schedules using Primavera P6. This includes long term strategic planning, shutdown planning and development project planning.      Establish baseline schedules, progress measurement methods, and schedule update routines to support accurate forecasting and performance tracking.      Establish yearly budgets, cost reports, forecasts, and performance metrics.      Monitor actual cost and commitments against budget and forecast, identifying trends, variances, and corrective actions.      Implement and maintain project risk management processes, including risk identification (threats and opportunities), assessment, mitigation planning, and monitoring.      Manage project change control processes to ensure that scope, schedule, cost, and risk impacts are properly assessed, approved, and recorded.      Prepare and issue regular project controls reports, dashboards, and management summaries for key stakeholders.      Support decision-making through scenario analysis, performance insight, and timely escalation of issues and risks.      Ensure alignment and consistency between planning, cost, risk, and reporting data across the project controls function.      Collaborate with project managers, work package owners, finance, procurement, and contractors to maintain robust project controls.      Contribute to continuous improvement of project controls standards, tools, templates, and governance. About you:     University degree in engineering, science, project management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.     Proven experience in project controls within large-scale technical, scientific, infrastructure, industrial, or engineering environments.     Proven experience leading and supervising multidisciplinary teams across planning, cost control, risk, change control, and reporting functions.     Experience establishing and managing project budgets, forecasts, cost reporting, and performance metrics.     Solid understanding of project governance, risk management, change control, and project lifecycle management principles.     Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, assess risks, and support decision-making.     Demonstrated ability to take initiative, and drive actions in a complex stakeholder environment.     Proven ability to lead, motivate, and supervise teams while fostering collaboration and accountability.     Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing reports and presenting information to diverse stakeholders.     Ability to work effectively in an international, multidisciplinary environment with multiple technical and operational interfaces. To apply: Working at ESS gives you the opportunity to contribute to the future discoveries within neutron science at a stunning, brand-new workplace filled with innovative minds and brilliant people from across the globe. We offer market competitive, individualised compensation which is differentiated according to role, responsibilities, individual skills, abilities and achievements as well as monthly pension contributions on top of your salary. If you see yourself in what we’re looking for, please provide your CV and motivation letter in English by clicking on “Apply” and following the instructions. Please be aware that we can only accept direct applications made via the ESS website. title: Full-Stack Engineer (Payments)
description: At Proposales, we're transforming how hotels sell and manage Groups, Meetings & Events. We're building a modern product platform for an industry that still relies heavily on legacy systems and manual processes, helping hotels move from inquiry to booking and delivery through beautifully designed software, automation and AI. It all runs in one connected flow, where prices, taxes and payments have to add up.We're now expanding beyond a proposal tool into a complete AI-powered platform for group sales and event management. As Full-Stack Engineer (Payments) you'll own the payment infrastructure across our different products. You'll join an experienced engineering team where good ideas win arguments. Expect us to challenge your designs, and expect to challenge ours. The role is based at our HQ in Stockholm, fully on-site.Your mission:    Own our payment infrastructure from idea to launch: shape the scope with product and leadership, design it, build it and follow it into use.    Design and build our payment provider integrations, covering payments, refunds, webhooks, payouts and reconciliation.    Make architecture decisions for flows where a mistake costs a hotel real money, with idempotency, retries and clear audit trails built in from the start.    Work across the rest of the platform too, in a TypeScript codebase that handles real bookings for hotels in more than 40 countries.    Review your colleagues' code, and have yours reviewed.    Work with finance and customer success to understand how hotels actually get paid, and turn that into product decisions.    Ensure secure and compliant payment operations, including PCI DSS, KYC, and evolving regulatory requirements as we scale our payments offering.A bit about you:    You have built and run payment systems in production, and you know what breaks in them.    Hands-on experience integrating payment providers. You can walk us through an integration you built and the decisions behind it.    You understand finance and fintech: how money moves, settlement, fees, currencies and reconciliation.    You review AI-generated code as carefully as your own.    You care that money is correct to the cent, and that code is still easy to change a year later.    Experience with several payment providers, or with hospitality tech, is a strong plus.    Fluent English, written and spoken.    You live in Stockholm, and want to work on-site with your team.Some of the technologies you'll work with:    TypeScript, React, Next.js    Node.js, PostgreSQL    Payment provider integrations    Vercel, AWSWhat we offer:    Real ownership. Payments is a growing part of Proposales, so you'll shape how it's built instead of inheriting someone else's design.    Problems worth solving. Many currencies, tax rules and hotel systems, all in one flow that has to add up.    A proven product. Proposales has been recognised as #1 in the Hotel Tech Awards for five consecutive years and is listed on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500 as one of the fastest-growing technology companies in the EMEA region.    Short decision lines. You'll work closely with leadership, and your ideas turn into action quickly.    Competitive salary that reflects your experience.    A personal development and wellbeing budget to invest in yourself.    A small, international, close-knit team in our Stockholm office, with an annual meetup and regular team activities.How we work:In payments, being correct matters more than being fast. Code goes through review, and the critical parts are covered by tests before anything reaches customers. We use AI agents every day: they speed up the work, but engineers own the design and the code. We're serverless first, hosted on Vercel.

title: Laboratory Engineer
description: Department of EcologyLaboratory EngineerWe are looking for a professional with hands-on research experience and leadership skills to lead a laboratory on terrestrial ecosystem ecology at the Department of Ecology. The laboratory focuses on studying the biogeochemistry of natural and managed ecosystem, with special emphasis on isotopic analyses (13C and 14C) to study the cycling of carbon in the terrestrial biosphere. This laboratory will specialize in the collection of samples from different terrestrial ecosystems and will process samples for subsequent submission to specialized isotopic laboratories. This laboratory will support scientific studies on the interactions between the terrestrial biosphere and the climate system, and the timescales of response of the terrestrial carbon cycle to anthropogenic perturbations.About the positionAs a laboratory engineer, you will oversee the day-to-day operations of sample collection, processing, delivery to other laboratories, and archival of samples. You will be in charge of organizing and conducting sampling campaigns, supervising users of the laboratory, and building a sample archive with a corresponding database. More specifically, the main duties include:    Establishing and managing a laboratory for processing of environmental samples (plants, soil, air) for isotopic analyses. During the first months of employment, the main tasks include the purchasing and installation of basic laboratory equipment.    Organizing and conducting fieldwork activities for the collection of environmental samples in remote national and international locations.    Processing of samples in the laboratory, which includes drying, sieving, grinding, storing, and delivering samples to other laboratories for isotope analyses.    Creating and managing a sample archive with a corresponding database.    Training and supervising researchers in the use of the laboratory.    Being responsible for maintaining safety standards in the laboratory.You will be part of the Ecosystem Ecology unit at the Department of Ecology. You will work with a team of senior and junior researchers, providing support for laboratory and fieldwork activities. You will also interact with other laboratory personnel internally at SLU and at other institutions in Sweden and abroad.Your profileRequirements:    Higher education degree in environmental sciences, biology, ecology, forestry or related discipline.    Experience with field collection and laboratory processing of environmental samples.    Ability to travel nationally and internationally to remote locations for periods of 1–4 weeks at a time, with flexibility regarding travel schedules.    Ability to communicate in English and Swedish.    Very good communication and team working skills.    Capacity to work independently.    A valid Swedish drivers license (B)Merit:    Experience with measurements of greenhouse gases and isotopes.    Experience working with databases and the R programming language.    Familiarity with concepts on the terrestrial carbon cycle.    Familiarity with the use of radiocarbon for the study of the terrestrial carbon cycle.About usAt the Department of Ecology in Uppsala, research and education are conducted with a focus on sustainable forestry and agricultural production, as well as effective nature conservation. We study the impacts of land-use and climate change on animals, plants, soil nutrient status, and greenhouse gas balances. Our work aims to find solutions that help mitigate ongoing climate change, conserve threatened species, promote biodiversity and ecosystem services, and manage pests—both in forest and agricultural landscapes and in urban environments.Read more about the department here: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/ecology/Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/Location:Uppsala.Form of employment:Permanent employment. SLU may apply a probationary employment period.Scope:100%.Start date:As agreed.Application:Please submit your application before deadline 2027-01-08. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.Union representatives:https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/ The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

title: Strategy Analyst
description: At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.This position reports to: Head of Strategy & M&A.Position overview:You will be a member of the Division's strategy team and report directly to the Division Head of Strategy. Together, the team provides the Division President and the Business Line leaders with the facts and analysis behind their strategic decisions.In a typical month you will research a market or a competitor, build the numbers behind a business case, profile a company proposed as an acquisition or partner, and prepare the material for the monthly follow-up of strategic initiatives. You will help shape strategic questions, conduct valuable research, get to validated numbers, collaborate across business lines and functions, and produce high-quality first drafts.We believe in combining careful thinking with modern tools. You should be comfortable using and building AI-enabled workflows and agents to accelerate analysis and execution, while maintaining responsibility for data security, accuracy, and ownership on the conclusions you draw.You are expected to form your own view, think critically constructively and professionally lead defined workstreams from question to decision-ready output.Key responsibilitiesAnalysis and drafting:    Researches markets, customers and competitors and analyzes internal business data to develop and evaluate growth opportunities.    Builds financial models (market size, growth, cost, profitability) and business plans, with sources and assumptions documented.    Produces high-quality first drafts of briefs, reports and presentations for Division, Business Area and corporate reviews.    Follows competitor, market and technology developments, keeps the Division's market data current and prepares regular updates for leadership.Planning and follow-up:    Supports the annual strategic planning cycle and the monthly follow-up of strategic initiatives: collects and checks input from the Business Lines, updates trackers and dashboards, and prepares the review material.Acquisitions and partnerships:    Screens and profiles companies and technologies as acquisition or partnership candidates, including inbound proposals, and keeps the pipeline records up to date.    Supports strategy projects and the Division's part in acquisition and partnership projects run with the Business Area Automation M&A team, including analysis, coordination of Business Line input and follow-up of assigned tasks.The strategy function:    Owns defined analytical workstreams supporting strategy workshops and leadership-team reviews, from preparation through follow-up.    Helps continuously improve the team's analytical tools, templates and AI-enabled ways of working.    Maintains the function's planning calendar, files and information base and responds to recurring information requests.Key requirements    Relevant professional experience: 5+ years of experience in management consulting, transaction advisory, corporate strategy, business development, business controlling, or a comparable analytical role in an industrial environment.    Academic background: University degree in business, economics, engineering, the natural sciences or a related discipline.    Financial and analytical capabilities: Solid financial-modelling skills and sound understanding of P&L, cash flow, business cases, valuation fundamentals and scenario analysis. Coordinateur technique / Technicien supérieur – Systèmes de sécurité (H/F)
================================================================================

***À propos de l'entreprise***  
*L'identité de l'entreprise reste confidentielle. Cette opportunité est proposée à titre exceptionnel aux entreprises suisses clientes de JobCloud, à condition qu'elles puissent démontrer à JobCloud l'existence d'un besoin légitime de confidentialité (par exemple, pour des raisons organisationnelles ou stratégiques). Dans ce cas, le nom de l'entreprise n'apparaît pas dans l'offre d'emploi. L'entreprise est seule responsable du processus de recrutement et du respect de la réglementation en matière de protection des données. Elle révèle, à sa seule discrétion, son identité au cours du processus de recrutement.*

 

Pour le compte d'une entreprise genevoise spécialisée dans les systèmes de sécurité électronique et les solutions techniques, nous recherchons un Coordinateur technique / Technicien supérieur afin de renforcer notre équipe.  
Nous recherchons un professionnel expérimenté, autonome et polyvalent, disposant de solides compétences techniques et capable d'assurer aussi bien la coordination des projets que les interventions sur le terrain.  
Ce poste s'adresse à un technicien confirmé souhaitant mettre à profit son expertise tout en assumant des responsabilités dans l'organisation, la réalisation et le suivi des installations.  
La fonction combine environ 50 % de coordination et de suivi de projets et 50 % d'activité technique sur le terrain.  


Responsabilités
----------------

### Coordination et suivi des projets

* Assurer la préparation, la planification et le suivi des projets d'installation de systèmes de sécurité.
* Organiser et coordonner les interventions des techniciens.
* Assurer le suivi technique des chantiers, depuis leur préparation jusqu'à leur mise en service et leur réception.
* Participer aux séances de chantier et assurer la communication avec les clients, architectes, directions de travaux et autres intervenants.
* Veiller au respect des délais, des exigences techniques et de la qualité des installations.
* Anticiper les besoins en matériel et assurer le suivi des approvisionnements.
* Suivre les dossiers techniques, les plans, les schémas et la documentation des installations.
* Identifier les difficultés techniques ou organisationnelles et proposer des solutions adaptées.
* Assurer le suivi des interventions et rendre compte de l'avancement des projets.


### Technique, programmation et interventions sur le terrain

* Réaliser et superviser les installations de systèmes de sécurité électronique.
* Effectuer la configuration, la programmation et la mise en service des systèmes de vidéosurveillance, de contrôle d'accès, d'alarme intrusion et d'interphonie.
* Assurer l'intégration et le bon fonctionnement des équipements sur les réseaux IP.
* Réaliser les tests, les contrôles de fonctionnement et les réceptions techniques.
* Diagnostiquer et résoudre de manière autonome les pannes et problèmes techniques rencontrés sur les installations.

title: CRM External Asset Manager - Basel
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: CRM External Asset Manager - Basel--- CRM External Asset Manager \- Basel===================================Description de l'entreprise---------------------------### Client:Our client is a well\-established international private banking and asset management group with a strong presence across key financial centres. The Bank combines the stability and heritage of a long\-standing financial institution with an entrepreneurial approach to investment and client service, with a clear focus on sustainable investment and creating long\-term value for clients.  The Bank places great importance on its people, their expertise and professional contribution, within an international environment where collaboration, personal accountability and high standards are valued. The Basel team is now looking to strengthen its External Asset Manager business with an experienced relationship professional.  Finders has worked with this client for many years and can provide candidates with a good understanding of the culture, team and working environment.Description du poste--------------------### Position:Based in Basel \- a delightful part of Switzerland \- this is a Client Relationship Manager position for the External Asset Manager segment. You will be joining a busy team and responsible for managing and developing the existing portfolio of EAM relationships (global client base). You will act as a key point of contact for clients, ensuring a high level of service while identifying opportunities to deepen existing relationships and generate new business. This is a hands\-on relationship role combining client management, business development and coordination with internal teams. You will work closely with the EAMs to understand their needs and provide appropriate banking, investment and operational solutions.### Key Responsibilities:* Manage and develop existing EAM relationships, while identifying opportunities for new business* Build trusted, long\-term relationships with external asset managers and their clients* Understand client requirements and coordinate appropriate banking and investment solutions* Promote the Bank’s products and services and contribute to business development initiatives* Prepare and participate in client meetings, events and presentations* Act as a key contact for day\-to\-day client enquiries and requests* Coordinate and monitor client instructions, including payments, securities transactions and changes to static data* Work closely with internal teams to ensure efficient and timely execution of client requirements* Monitor credit lines, investment maturities and other relevant client matters* Ensure activities are carried out in line with applicable internal policies and regulatory requirements, including AML, FATCA and MiFID* Follow up on administrative and operational matters to ensure a high level of client service### Why Apply?This is an opportunity to join an established international private bank in a relationship\-focused role where you can take ownership of a portfolio of EAM relationships and play an active part in developing the business. You will benefit from a broad role combining relationship management, business development and exposure to investment and banking solutions, within a collaborative and international environment. The position would suit someone who enjoys being close to clients, working across different teams and building relationships over the long term.Profil recherché-----------------### Candidate Profile:### Candidate Profile* University degree in Finance, Economics or a related discipline,* Around 5–10 years' relevant experience within Private Banking or Financial Services, ideally with exposure to External Asset Managers* Swiss private banking experience is highly desirable, but not essential* Strong understanding of private banking products, services and client processes, combined with a client\-focused approach and excellent communication and relationship\-building skills* Commercial mindset with the confidence to identify and develop business opportunities* Well organised and able to prioritise effectively, manage multiple matters and work under pressure* A hands\-on, “get things done” mindset, with the initiative and flexibility to take ownership and find practical solutions* Strong sense of responsibility, integrity and attention to detail, with the ability to work effectively with a range of internal and external stakeholders* Excellent Microsoft Office skills; experience with Avaloq would be an advantage* Fluent and English; additional languages would be an advantage* Swiss work permit eligibility required; cross\-border candidates are welcome. The role is fully office\-based, with a commitment to living in or near Basel expected\#LI\-SG1![FINDERS SA]()* FINDERS SA  Avenue du Théâtre 7  1005 Lausanne*jid7e26606jm jit1148jm jiy26jm

Remote. Vertriebsassistentin Outbound=================================================== **Dein Alltag**Du hast Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen, gehst offen auf andere zu und schaffst es, mit deiner sympathischen Interesse zu wecken? Darüber hinaus recherchierst du neue potenzielle Kunden, erweiterst die bestehende Datenbank und trägst aktiv dazu bei, neue Marktpotenziale zu erschliessen. Mit deinem Gespür für Menschen, deiner Hartnäckigkeit und deiner positiven leistest du einen direkten Beitrag zum Vertriebserfolg.  **Dein Profil*** Freude am Telefonieren und am aktiven Austausch mit Menschen* Kommunikationsstarke, offene und sympathische Persönlichkeit* Überzeugungskraft sowie ein sicheres und selbstbewusstes Auftreten* Organisationstalent und strukturierte Arbeitsweise* Eigeninitiative, Zielorientierung und Durchhaltevermögen* Freude daran, neue Kontakte aufzubauen und Chancen zu erkennen* Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, ösischkenntnisse von Vorteil  **Deine Benefits**Dich erwartet eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel Eigenverantwortung und einem hohen Mass an Flexibilität. Du arbeitest vollständig aus dem Homeoffice und profitierst gleichzeitig von den Strukturen, der Stabilität und den Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten eines erfolgreichen Unternehmens. Neben einem Fixlohn profitierst du von einem leistungsorientierten Provisionsmodell mit entsprechendem Verdienstpotenzial und überdurchschnittlichen Sozialleistungen. Für deinen Homeoffice\-Arbeitsplatz wird Dir ein Laptop sowie ein Headset zur Verfügung gestellt. Dank flexiblen Arbeitszeiten organisierst du deinen Arbeitstag selbstständig, eigenverantwortlich sowie gewinnbringend. description:
Scientist Lab Technician Assay Development
------------------------------------------

Roche Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics and is home to key research and development functions. For our long-standing client, Roche Diagnostics International AG in Rotkreuz, we are looking for a

Scientist Lab Technician Assay Development
==========================================

**Background:**

The Assay Development team is responsible for the development of molecular diagnostic and screening tests based on PCR technology in the areas of infectious diseases, genomics, and oncology, from early feasibility to commercial launch. Our main areas of responsibility include initial prototyping; optimization of assay design to meet product requirements and ensure manufacturability; development of test methods and acceptance criteria; transfer of reagent manufacturing instructions, test methods, and workflows to Operations; the design and execution of verification and validation activities, including guard-band studies, stability studies, and technical performance verification studies; and documentation of analytical performance for product labeling and regulatory submission packages. Throughout the product development phases, Assay Development interfaces with various departments including Research, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, and Business in order to create and realize what patients need next.

**Tasks \& Responsibilities:**

* You work with high-throughput lab analyzers.
* You perform routine lab work with infectious samples and lead your own experiments, including their analysis.
* You plan and execute various work packages for the development of molecular diagnostic tests.
* You participate in project meetings and present experimental data.
* You ensure precise documentation of experiments using electronic lab journals according to GMP standards.
* You handle and maintain laboratory equipment.
* You perform statistical data analysis using various software and tools (e.g., JMP).
* You author official documents (e.g., Design History Files).

**Must Haves:**

* Graduate as Biomedical Analyst Scientist (BMA HF) or apprenticeship as Lab Technician (Biology, Medical Diagnostics, Chemistry) or at least Bachelor or Master degree in Life Sciences with practical experience from the Lab (no PhD graduates)
* Ideally 2+ years of lab experience with data analyses and biostatistics
* Very good and thorough documentation skills
* English fluency written and orally is a must, German is a plus
* Open-minded team player
* Pro-active mindset and organized working style
* Flexible, strategic thinking and self-dependent person

**Nice to Haves:**

* Lab experience from a biotechnical environment with infectious sample handling Biosafety Level 2
* Experience in a GMP/GLP environment

**What we offer:**

* The opportunity to work for one of the world's leading pharmaceutical companies
* A modern campus with extensive green spaces and social areas
* A central location with easy motorway access and a nearby train station
* A varied and engaging range of responsibilities
* The option to work from home
* Further training opportunities through temptraining
* The opportunity to work in a dynamic and motivated team
* Attractive remuneration

title: CEO
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: CEO (all genders)--- CEO (all genders)=================CEO (all genders)-----------------Execution, growth and the path to profitabilityYou take over overall responsibility for day\-to\-day business from the founder and drive the execution of our strategy, market launches and expansion. You own the P\&L and lead Tortuga Sense from market entry to a scaling, profitable company, reaching break\-even according to plan and preparing the next financing round on solid numbers. **Workload:** 100%**Location:** Zug, Switzerland**Start date:** Q1 2027**Reports to:** Board of Directors Tortuga Sense is a Swiss preventive health company: science\-based supplements, diagnostics and , our AI\-powered health companion, complemented by an academy and a community under the claim “From Cell to Consciousness”. The portfolio is in market and expansion beyond Switzerland is under way.Today, the Chairman of the Board, one of the founders, fills the CEO role ad interim. You lead a growing team, including a Head of Marketing joining in Q1 2027\. The Board owns the strategy. You are involved from day one and take the lead in developing it over the medium term. We deliberately stay lean and use current AI tools and automation wherever they make us faster and keep costs under control. ### **About Tortuga Sense*** **Markets:** Switzerland since spring 2026, Germany and Austria since November 2026 through an EU fulfilment partner, APAC planned for Q2 2027 through a joint venture.* **Range:** Eleven products in four lines (ELEMENT, CORE, COGNITION, REGENERATION), growing to 15 to 20 by the end of 2027\. Proprietary formulations built on clinically studied branded ingredients, made with our pharma\-grade Swiss partner (cGMP, ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, HACCP).* **Channels:** Our own D2C webshop plus B2B through physicians, therapists, pharmacies and studios, trained through our Deep Sense programme. Five practitioner partners are on board, more are in negotiation.*  **:** Turns blood values, personal goals and lifestyle information into personalised supplement recommendations. Developed by our parent company, version 1 planned for 2027; Tortuga Sense is its licensee and first user.### **Your responsibilities*** Translate the strategy into an annual plan, budget and quarterly targets, and deliver on them. Lead the management team and develop the strategy further with the Board.* Own the P\&L. Finance leadership currently sits with the Chairman, supported by finance administration. You work closely within it and build budget control, KPIs and reporting.* Own revenue and unit economics across D2C and the practitioner channel, together with the Head of Marketing.* Expand the practitioner channel: a closed area with in\-depth information for professional customers (two areas), and scalable onboarding and acquisition supported by automation, together with the Deep Sense Academy.* Run operations: the flow of goods from manufacturer via fulfilment partner to customer, inventory and liquidity, customer service and the set\-up of the EU entity.* Generate ideas for new products together with the Chairman, the board member responsible for medical and the Head of Marketing, and contribute to the profitability of the portfolio.* Own market launches and expansion: lead country set\-up and market access through the regulatory staff function, which reports to you with direct escalation to the Board, and represent Tortuga Sense in the APAC joint venture.* Anchor in sales and customer care, and define its requirements from our perspective as its first customer.* Lead and develop the team, including a Head of Marketing joining in Q1 2027 and a growing number of employees, and protect the company’s mindset as it grows.* Support the next financing round, led by the Chairman: deliver figures, KPIs and planning, and answer investors’ questions.* **Division of roles:** Product development, formulations, claims and medical sit with board members in active roles and our manufacturing partner; development, IP and data sit with our parent company. The Board retains overall direction and strategy, finance leadership, group structure, capital rounds, budget approval and appointments to the management team.### **What you bring*** You have played a key role in building a digital brand or start\-up from an early stage, as founder, managing director, COO, CMO or first executive, and now want overall responsibility. What you have built counts for more than years of service.* Shaped by start\-ups, D2C or digital consumer brands, ideally in health, supplements or wellbeing. Not a corporate or pharma profile.* Deep expertise in at least one core area of a consumer brand, whether operations, finance, growth or marketing, and the breadth to lead and challenge the others without doing those jobs yourself.* Strong with numbers: you think unit economics, inventory and liquidity together.* You work with current AI tools as a matter of course and can show where automation made processes faster or leaner.* regulatory understanding of dietary supplements.* Business\-fluent and English.* You share our purpose: “We don’t sell pills. We build rituals.” Prevention and awareness are a personal concern, not just a market segment.* Entrepreneurial, clear and calm. You say what is, don’t overpromise, and deliver. You lead without ego and work closely with founders who sit on the Board and hold active roles: you draw on their knowledge and still set boundaries.### **This is a plus*** Experience with contract manufacturers and fulfilment partners.* Practitioner or partner sales in a health setting.* Experience with digital health products.* Experience building international markets.* Fundraising experience is not a requirement.### **What awaits you*** Overall responsibility for day\-to\-day business, alongside an active Chairman with thirty years of entrepreneurial experience who hands over step by step.* The chance to build the leadership team around your strengths and help choose the next key hires.* An independent brand with a medical foundation, exclusive formulations and an ecosystem of product, health intelligence and community.* A fixed salary at start\-up level and a substantial, performance\-based equity participation in Tortuga Sense AG.In your first 60 days, you have taken over the 2027 budget and the organisation, and the delegation of authority is lived in practice. A KPI cockpit covering cohorts, CAC, repeat purchase and contribution margin is in place, clear priorities are agreed with the Head of Marketing, and the next key hires are defined.By mid\-2027, Germany and Austria are on track against their targets and APAC has launched. v1 is part of the sales process, the professional area is live with scalable practitioner onboarding, and supply runs without bottlenecks.By the end of 2027, the data room and figures for the next financing round are ready, the range comprises 15 to 20 products, the practitioner channel is significantly expanded, and there is a proven path to break\-even.**Sound like you?**Then we would like to talk. Send us a few lines about yourself, two or three things you have built with the numbers behind them, and one example of how you used AI or automation to change the way a business works. No formal cover letter required. Feel free to apply in either English or . Please also mention your notice period and possible starting date.For further questions, feel free to reach out to us directly.![Purpur Ventures AG]()* Purpur Ventures AG  Grienbachstrasse 17  6300 Zug*jid4e2e308jm jit1148jm jiy26jm

description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Gestionnaire prestations PGM Romandie et Tessin (80-100%) --- Gestionnaire prestations PGM Romandie et Tessin (80\\-100%) ========================================================== À PROPOS DE NOUS ----------------- Chez enovetic SA, nous simplifions et mettons en réseau l'administration du travail, de la santé et de la prévoyance. Grâce à nos produits et services, nos clients maximisent leur productivité et peuvent ainsi se concentrer sur leurs compétences clés. En tant que fournisseur leader de solutions d'externalisation sur mesure pour la location de services et les caisses de pension, nous disposons de vastes connaissances d'experts combinées à des solutions de plateforme modernes. Avec une gestion complète de la santé en entreprise (GSE), une assurance collective d'indemnités journalières en cas de maladie (PGM) spécifique pour le secteur ainsi que la plateforme eAbsence spécialement développée pour l'annonce des absences pour cause de maladie ou d'accident, l'entreprise enovetic soutient ses clients de manière proactive dans la promotion de la santé et la prévention sur le lieu de travail. En tant que gestionnaire au sein de l'équipe Prestations PGM Romandie et Tessin, tu assures, avec tes collègues, les meilleures prestations possibles pour nos clients. Tu soutiens et conseilles nos clients sur toutes les questions liées aux indemnités journalières maladie et au placement de personnel, notamment en ce qui concerne la couverture d'assurance, l'obligation de prestations, la gestion des absences et le suivi des dossiers, jusqu'aux décomptes d'indemnités journalières et à la facturation des primes. Tu accomplis tout cela avec un sens marqué du service, de l'efficacité et de l'autonomie. CE QUI T'ATTEND ----------------- \* Tu vérifies la couverture d'assurance et l'obligation de prestations dans le cadre des absences professionnelles annoncées, conformément aux dispositions applicables de la solution IJM pour la branche du placement de personnel ainsi qu'au contrat d'assurance. \* Tu assumes de manière autonome la gestion des absences et le triage des cas selon les processus et critères définis. \* Tu accompagnes et conseilles activement les entreprises assurées et gardes une vue d'ensemble grâce à notre solution logicielle interne eAbsence. \* En tant qu'agence d'assurance indépendante de SWICA, tu annonces les cas, demandes les documents médicaux nécessaires et assures la coordination complète entre les différents intervenants, garantissant ainsi un traitement correct et rapide des cas IJM annoncés. \* Tu établis les décomptes d'indemnités journalières maladie pour les entreprises assurées. \* Tu contribues à la facturation mensuelle des primes. CE QUE TU APPORTES ------------------ \* Tu disposes d'une formation commerciale de base et idéalement d'une formation complémentaire comme spécialiste en assurances sociales avec brevet fédéral ou comme spécialiste en assurance. \* Idéalement, tu apportes de solides connaissances dans le domaine des assurances de personnes et de la perte de gain, ainsi qu'une expérience pratique dans la gestion des sinistres d'une assurance IJM. \* Tu aimes travailler de manière autonome, orientée objectifs, responsable et fiable. \* Tu es à l'aise avec les outils informatiques et t'intéresses à l'optimisation des processus et au travail en projet. \* Tu parviens à t'adresser de manière adéquate aux personnes assurées et aux partenaires, et à répondre à leurs demandes de façon orientée solutions et avec considération. \* Tu maîtrises parfaitement le français à l'oral comme à l'écrit ; la connaissance d'autres langues est un atout. CE QUE NOUS OFFRONS ------------------- \* Une activité intéressante et variée dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant \* Une grande autonomie dans ton travail, avec des responsabilités à la hauteur de tes compétences et de ton engagement \* Site attractif à Lausanne avec des équipements modernes et une bonne accessibilité (transports publics et voiture) \* Règlement du temps de travail moderne avec possibilités de travail hybrides \* Solution de caisse de pension supérieure à la moyenne \* Participation aux abonnements TP et Park\\+Rail Pose dès aujourd'hui ta candidature pour la prochaine étape de ta carrière chez enovetic ! Nous sommes impatients d'en savoir plus sur toi.
